articles.title: L’armée de Terre teste un massif bulldozer téléopéré de 45 tonnes pour ouvrir les champs de mines
articles.text:
La Section technique de l’armée de Terre poursuit l’évaluation de l’EBMZ, un impressionnant bulldozer téléopéré de 45 tonnes conçu pour ouvrir un passage dans un champ de mines. Développé en 19 mois, il est destiné aux sapeurs du génie.
L'armée de Terre a désormais à sa disposition un nouveau bulldozer téléopéré pour franchir les champs de mines. Baptisé EBMZ, pour engin de bréchage mécanique de zone, il a été développé et livré en à peine 19 mois, un délai très court pour un programme d'armement, et ses évaluations se poursuivent avec les régiments du génie. Construit sur un Caterpillar D7 blindé, il se pilote à distance pendant le bréchage, c'est-à-dire l'ouverture d'un passage à travers les mines.
EBMZ, le bulldozer de l'armée de Terre qui laboure les mines, cabine vide
Comme le détaille la Section technique de l'armée de Terre (STAT), qui présente l'engin, ce bréchage est confié à une charrue montée à l'avant du D7. Elle plonge dans le sol, soulève la terre et pousse sur les côtés les mines qui s'y cachent. Derrière elle se dessine alors un couloir sécurisé, au sein duquel les troupes peuvent progresser. On peut régler sa profondeur selon la dureté du terrain et la façon dont les mines antichars ont été enfouies. Au passage, la puissance de l'engin lui permet d'écarter la végétation basse et les jeunes arbres.
La téléopération a été l'un des gros casse-tête du projet. Il faut savoir que pendant le bréchage, personne ne reste dans la cabine. Le bulldozer est piloté à distance, depuis une zone de sécurité. L'opérateur prend alors place dans un véhicule blindé garé à proximité, équipé d'un poste de télécommande transportable. Pour éviter de perdre le contrôle de l'engin, les ordres circulent par deux liaisons, l'une par radio, l'autre par fibre optique, c'est le fameux principe de la redondance, où une liaison peut prendre le relais de l'autre.
Pour ce système, l'armée a d'ailleurs choisi une solution française spécialisée dans le pilotage à distance des engins de chantier. Son objectif est ici de ne pas dépendre d'un fournisseur étranger, et d'obtenir plus vite une aide technique en cas de besoin.
Un bulldozer modulable qui sait aussi voyager
Ouvrir des brèches dans les champs de mines n'est pas la seule mission prévue pour l'EBMZ, que ses concepteurs ont voulu polyvalent. Lors de ses autres phases d'emploi, sa cabine n'a plus à rester vide. Deux personnes peuvent y prendre place, protégées par un habitacle entièrement blindé et équipé de caméras haute résolution.
Surtout, l'EBMZ réunit plusieurs équipements sur un même engin, un peu comme un tracteur dont on change l'outil. La charrue se retire, et le D7 peut alors servir à aménager le terrain pour les troupes ou à les appuyer lors de combats en ville. Le système comprend enfin des équipements pour déplacer les mines et baliser le couloir ouvert, afin que ceux qui suivent sachent précisément par où passer.
Faire voyager 45 tonnes, c'était l'autre grand défi. L'EBMZ voyage pour cela sur une remorque extra-surbaissée, dont le plateau est très proche du sol, et déboîtable, c'est-à-dire que son avant se détache pour laisser l'engin monter à bord. Elle roule aussi bien sur route que sur chemin, permet de déployer l'EBMZ à l'échelle européenne et a été pensée pour être utilisée facilement avec la charrue. Après 19 mois de développement, place aux essais donc. Ils réunissent le groupement MOB-AGESTER (mobilité et agencement de l'espace terrestre) de la STAT, qui évalue les nouveaux matériels, la Direction générale de l'armement (DGA), qui pilote les programmes d'armement, et la SIMMT, chargée de leur entretien. Ensemble, ils poursuivent les expérimentations et comptent sur les retours d'expérience des régiments du génie, autrement dit les remarques des sapeurs qui prennent l'engin en main, pour le faire évoluer pas à pas. Le post de la STAT mentionne le 13e et le 19e régiment du génie, ainsi que la Brigade du génie.

articles.title: Millions of California students have sensitive data stolen — names, SSIDs, home addresses and more taken in attack on nonprofit
articles.text:
Millions of California students have sensitive data stolen — names, SSIDs, home addresses and more taken in attack on nonprofit
Sensitive, personally identifiable information leaked
- California Department of Education third-party partner falls victim to a data breach attack
- An estimated three years' worth of students (5.7 million per year) likely affected
- It seems access was obtained by a simple password theft
Malwarebytes has reported that millions of current and former California public school students have had their sensitive personal information stole following a massive data breach.
The breach occurred in a Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) system used by Educational Testing Service (ETS) – a third party used by the California Department of Education for managing student information.
According to the report, the attackers were able to regain entry repeatedly over the course of four months, accessing student files filled with names, addresses, dates of birth and more.
California student system breach likely impacting millions
Though ETS hasn't officially disclosed how many students have been impacted, Malwarebytes notes that the state's public schools counted more than 5.7 million students in the 2025-2026 year alone. The state's Department of Education believes students who enrolled in the previous three years could be impacted – or around 17 million students if all three years were equal.
The sensitive files were accessed and copied multiple times between May 22 and September 18, with the activity finally being discovered on September 25, and it all comes down to human vulnerability.
Rather than a software vulnerability, the attackers are believed to have gained access via compromised credentials, though the intricacies around the specific attack vector haven't been shared yet.
ETS and the California Department of Education are both working to notify impacted individuals, who are being given 24 months of identity protection software for free. No evidence seems to have been found to prove that the stolen information has been publicly released, and it doesn't seem that a ransom threat has been made.

articles.title: Linux Foundation Finds "25% Of Incoming Pull Requests are Considered AI Slop"
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 20th 2026
Linux Foundation Finds "25% Of Incoming Pull Requests are Considered AI Slop"
AI-generated code in the realm of Linux has been responsible for more than a little upheaval in recent months, with some projects seeing heated debates surrounding the topic. Other project developers have expressed frustration with an uptick in what they call "AI slop PRs," which they say have increased maintainer workload to unreasonable levels. The Linux Foundation recently conducted a survey of Linux project maintainers, who reported that generative AI has resulted in increased productivity, but the research also finds that there has been a substantial increase in low-quality AI slop PRs, as prior anecdotes predicted.
Summary
- Linux Foundation Research published a new study examining how generative AI (GenAI) is reshaping open source software (OSS) development.
- The research uncovered significant productivity gains alongside growing maintainer pressures.
- A majority (59%) of project maintainers report growing contributions to OSS, but 25% of incoming pull requests (PRs) are estimated to be low-quality "AI slop."
- For both contributors and maintainers, GenAI boosts productivity by up to 50% across all types of OSS development tasks.
- The findings point to a need for stronger AI governance, including clear contribution policies, standardized attribution and verification and continued investment in human mentorship.
One major take-away from the study was that there is a lag between AI contributions in open-source and policies surrounding the technology, with this lag largely spurred by the aforementioned, often lengthy and charged, debates about how to regulate AI-generated code submissions and the increasing difficult in detecting them.
Governance hasn't caught up with adoption: Only 35% of projects have a formal policy permitting GenAI use, while 32% have no policy and no plans for one. Among contributors, 61% conduct detailed reviews and full functional testing of AI-generated code before submission, but disclosure of AI assistance remains inconsistent.
As expected, the study found that 71% of maintainers agreed that generative AI coding agents reduced the barrier to entry for open-source participation, but 53% disagree that generative AI has improved community trust. Respondents also reported that generative AI has accelerated more than just coding workflows, with proposal discussions and code authoring seeing improvements. These efficiency gains were beneficial to maintainers, because they now had more time to complete other tasks. 66% of developers reported that they were using that extra time to address technical debt, while 63% spent the time developing new features, and 58% used it for learning. 
There were, however, drawbacks to using generative AI, with 21% of respondents finding that high-complexity tasks actually took longer with generative AI than without. 59% of maintainers report that contribution volume has increased since generative coding became popular, but an estimated 25% of incoming PRs are considered "AI slop"—a number that rises to 31% in larger projects. Curiously, project maintainers appear to be split on how generative AI coding impacts the need for mentorship, with 46% saying it increased the need for new contributor mentorship, while 32% said it decreased that need. 
Overall, the results in this Linux Foundation study largely mirror those we've seen in previous studies polling game developers and artists, with game industry workers often split on generative AI, depending on their workload, with positive sentiments about the tech largely coming from the coding side of the industry, while the art and quality assurance departments largely eschew the tech.
Sources:
				The Linux Foundation News, 				The Linux Foundation

A X9900LS tem Google TV como sistema operacional, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, porta Ethernet, saída de áudio óptica e 4 entradas HDMI — sendo 2 HDMI 2.1 e 2 HDMI 2.0.
A Toshiba M450SS é uma TV que combina MiniLED e pontos quânticos (QLED) em resolução 4K, utilizando LEDs menores na retroiluminação do painel LCD, o que pode permitir um controle mais localizado da luz, enquanto os pontos quânticos ajudam a ampliar a reprodução de cores.
O modelo está disponível em 55″ e 65 polegadas com taxa de atualização de 60 Hz, brilho de 300 nits e compatibilidade com HDR10+. O painel de 60 Hz atende ao uso cotidiano, ao streaming e a jogos em frequências compatíveis, mas tem fluidez inferior a modelos com 120 Hz.
Seu sistema operacional é o VIDAA (baseado em Linux), com processador Engine ZR com recursos de IA, Modo Game, Game Deck, controle por voz, Wi-Fi e Bluetooth, além de três entradas HDMI.
A Toshiba M450RS está disponível no mercado brasileiro com 50″ e 75 polegadas. O modelo tem painel QLED e iluminação MiniLED para um controle mais localizado da luz, maior fidelidade de cores e contraste mais definido em comparação com sistemas LED convencionais.
A TV traz taxa de atualização em 60 Hz, processador com recursos de IA integrados, Modo Game, conectividade Wi-Fi e entradas HDMI e USB, além de funções de áudio e imagem assistidas por inteligência artificial.
Seu sistema operacional é o VIDAA e não usa Google TV. Então, pode ser que o usuário encontre limitações na oferta de aplicativos, já que a Play Store não estará disponível.
A resolução é uma das principais diferenças da Toshiba V45SS em relação às TVs 4K deste guia. O modelo está disponível com tamanhos entre 32″ e 50 polegadas, com painel QLED com resolução Full HD (1920 × 1080 pixels) e taxa de atualização de 60 Hz.
Essa tecnologia amplia a gama de cores reproduzidas pelo painel, mas não aumenta a definição das imagens por se tratar de uma tela com resolução inferior a 4K.
A V45SS também utiliza a plataforma VIDAA, com loja de aplicativos e navegador. A conectividade divulgada pela marca inclui Wi-Fi de duas bandas, Bluetooth 5.0, Ethernet, 2 entradas HDMI 1.4 — uma delas com eARC — e 1 porta USB 2.0.
A Toshiba C350NS utiliza um painel LCD com retroiluminação LED convencional, identificado pela marca como DLED. Essa tecnologia tem foco em oferecer contraste e iluminação aprimorada com melhor custo-benefício, com tamanhos que variam entre 50″ e 75 polegadas.
O conjunto atende à reprodução de filmes, séries, transmissões e streaming, mas a não traz mesma qualidade oferecida em painéis MiniLED, por exemplo. O sistema VIDAA oferece acesso a aplicativos como Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+ e Apple TV+, conforme a disponibilidade na plataforma.
Algumas versões da linha possuem 3 entradas HDMI 1.4, 2 USB 2.0, 1 Ethernet, Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.0, saída óptica e entrada AV, além de espelhamento de tela e controle remoto com comando de voz. A quantidade de entradas HDMI aumenta para 4 em modelos maiores.
Com tela de 32 polegadas e resolução HD, a Toshiba 32V35L tem uma proposta diferente das TVs maiores. O painel DLED utiliza retroiluminação LED convencional e traz resolução inferior ao Full HD e ao 4K em quantidade de pixels.
Isso não impede o uso para acompanhar canais de televisão, assistir a vídeos e acessar serviços de streaming, mas significa que a tela não apresenta o mesmo nível de detalhe de um painel de resolução superior.
A ficha técnica informa taxa de atualização de 60 Hz e brilho de 180 nits, que pode não ser suficiente para ambientes mais claros. O modelo não tem compatibilidade com HDR e o áudio integrado utiliza dois alto-falantes de 6 W cada, com Dolby Audio.
Para conectar outros dispositivos, a TV conta com duas entradas HDMI 1.4, duas USB, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, entrada AV e saída óptica. Ela não tem Bluetooth integrado.
A escolha depende do espaço disponível, da qualidade de imagem desejada e dos recursos necessários para conectar aparelhos e acessar aplicativos. Antes de comprar, vale observar:
A Toshiba DLED 32V35L é a melhor opção para quartos pequenos da lista devido ao tamanho da tela. Seus 60 Hz de taxa de atualização atendem ao uso cotidiano, mas o modelo não é uma das melhores TVs de 32 polegadas disponíveis no mercado, já que tem resolução limitada a HD e não vem com Bluetooth integrado.
A Toshiba tem TVs com diferentes propostas, desde modelos HD básicos até opções 4K com tecnologias QLED, MiniLED e OLED. Para saber se uma TV é boa, é preciso avaliar e comparar as especificações do modelo com a de outras marcas.
A escolha depende da resolução, do tipo de painel, do sistema operacional e das características de cada aparelho. Modelos como a 32V35L atendem a usos básicos, enquanto linhas mais avançadas podem oferecer recursos de imagem adicionais para jogos e streaming.
No Brasil, o sistema das TVs Toshiba varia conforme a linha: alguns modelos usam a plataforma VIDAA, enquanto outros vêm com Google TV, baseado no Android TV.
As TVs Toshiba são comercializadas pelo Grupo Multi, antigo Grupo Multilaser, que se identifica como revendedor oficial da marca no país. A operação brasileira está vinculada ao uso da marca Toshiba em televisores.
Não. Toshiba e Multi (antiga Multilaser) são marcas distintas. No Brasil, o Grupo Multi é o revendedor oficial das TVs Toshiba e também comercializa televisores sob sua própria marca. Assim, os produtos podem pertencer ao mesmo canal comercial, mas têm identificação de marca e linhas diferentes.
Não. TCL e Toshiba são marcas distintas, com operações e linhas de televisores próprias. No Brasil, a TCL atua por meio da TCL SEMP, parceria entre a empresa chinesa TCL e a brasileira SEMP. Já as TVs Toshiba são comercializadas localmente pelo Grupo Multi.

articles.title: Hovering a helicopter over a Beyoncé concert, 'police ride-alongs', and a 40th birthday spent in a nightclub — Rockstar did heavy research on Miami for GTA 6 and even met people who 'want to tell you every crime they or their friends have ever done'
articles.text:
GTA 6 devs rode in a helicopter over a Beyoncé concert and met 'colorful characters' who revealed their crimes while researching Miami — 'As soon as they know where you're from, they just want to tell you every crime they or their friends have ever done'
Rockstar also visited "some scary places"
- Bloomberg's Jason Schreier says Rockstar Games went on trips to Miami for research for Grand Theft Auto 6
- Rockstar went on "police ride-alongs" and "wound up hovering over a Beyoncé concert" in a helicopter
- The developers also met people who revealed their past crimes when they learned the team worked on GTA
Rockstar Games did extensive research on Miami for Grand Theft Auto 6 and even encountered people who shared about past crimes when they learned the developers worked on GTA.
Speaking in a new YouTube video about his time at Rockstar North and his behind-the-scenes experience seeing GTA 6 before the general public, Bloomberg's Jason Schreier said he was told about the many trips Rockstar developers, including artists and leadership, made to Miami.
Since Miami and Los Angeles inspired GTA 6's Vice City, the team chose to do in-person research. They went on group trips and "went all over the place" for inspiration, even doing "police ride-alongs" and visiting "some scary places."
"At one point, some of the artists were in a helicopter taking photos of aerial views of the city, and they wound up hovering over a Beyoncé concert," Schreier said.
Speaking more about the ride-alongs, Rockstar also met tons of "really colorful characters" in Miami who shared their own life experiences with the developers.
Senior vice president of technology Jonathan Ashcroft revealed to Schreier that he spent his 40th birthday at a nightclub during one of these trips and said it was funny because he and some other developers were "these light-skinned Scottish people just like looking totally out of place wandering around this club" and "scrutinizing the lighting instead while everyone else around them is partying."
Returning to these "colorful characters" Rockstar met, Ashcroft said that they would divulge information about past crimes when they learned the team worked on GTA.

articles.title: Google unveils TorchTPU in a push to break Nvidia's stranglehold on AI compute - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Google unveils TorchTPU in a push to break Nvidia’s stranglehold on AI compute
Google LLC is striving to pry open Nvidia Corp.’s grip on the artificial intelligence computing industry with the launch of a specialized version of the open-source PyTorch framework, called TorchTPU, which is designed to eliminate a key advantage of its rival.
One of the reasons why Nvidia and its graphics processing units remain so dominant in the AI industry is that the vast majority of AI applications are written specifically to run on its GPUs, and it’s this reality that Google is trying to change with today’s release.
The PyTorch framework is a popular open-source toolkit that developers use to create, train and run AI models and neural networks. According to some accounts, more than 85% of all AI applications are created using PyTorch, which was created by Meta Platforms Inc. in 2016, long before anyone realized that large language models would come along to enable the AI boom.
Back then, Nvidia’s GPUs were already the preferred hardware used by developers for AI research, so Meta designed PyTorch specifically to work with that company’s chips. The focus on Nvidia’s hardware has continued, even after Meta open-sourced PyTorch in 2022, handing over stewardship to the nonprofit Linux Foundation.
With TorchTPU, Google has created an alternative version of PyTorch that makes it easier for developers to create models and applications that can run on its Tensor Processing Units or TPUs, which are specialized chips for AI workloads. TorchTPU also provides a simple way for developers to run existing apps and models on TPUs by making a few simple configuration tweaks, without having to rewrite any of the underlying code.
Google isn’t alone in trying to undermine the massive advantage Nvidia had thanks to PyTorch. In fact, it was just earlier this week that Amazon Web Services Inc. announced its own flavor of PyTorch, called TorchNeuron. Similar to TorchTPU, TorchNeuron makes it easy to run AI applications on different hardware, in this case Amazon’s Trainum chips. Amazon went even further, revealing that it has contributed code to the original PyTorch project that will decouple a number of key features from Nvidia’s GPUs, with the aim being to make it more compatible with any kind of hardware.
Google didn’t do that, but it may have gained an advantage over AWS in a couple of other ways. For one thing, the company said it collaborated closely with Meta, Hugging Face and a couple of startups called Inferact Inc. and RadixArk Inc., the developers of vLLM and SGLang, to ensure that various TorchTPU features and code libraries are compatible with their developer tools. With that, it has erased another advantage PyTorch brings.
Google also did something else that AWS didn’t. It revealed a new tool called the TPU agent suite that is meant to help developers move their AI applications to the Google Cloud platform and automatically fix any errors that occur during the migration process. Furthermore, it updated an existing tool called LiteRT, which is used to build AI applications that run directly smartphones, laptops and embedded devices rather than in the cloud. So it should now be compatible with PyTorch-based apps, Google said.
Of course, it will take more than this to convince millions of developers to drop Nvidia’s GPUs and rush to Google’s TPUs. But it does suggest that Google is confident it can chip away at Nvidia’s lead in the longer term.

articles.title: Zoom lanza un detector de deepfakes para frenar fraudes y suplantaciones en videollamadas
articles.text:
Zoom integrará en diciembre de 2026 una herramienta de detección de riesgos de deepfake en sus videollamadas.
La función analizará en tiempo real señales de video y audio para identificar si la imagen o la voz de un participante pudieron haber sido alteradas fuera de la plataforma.
El sistema mostrará una alerta ante posibles contenidos sintéticos e incluirá un indicador de confianza. Su objetivo es ayudar a detectar intentos de suplantación en entrevistas laborales, reuniones corporativas y contactos con proveedores o clientes, escenarios en los que una identidad falsa puede facilitar fraudes.
La novedad fue anunciada durante Zoomtopia, la conferencia anual de clientes de la compañía.
Zoom prevé que la función esté disponible en diciembre de 2026, en un contexto en el que las herramientas de inteligencia artificial permiten crear videos y audios cada vez más difíciles de distinguir de los reales.
Otras funciones de inteligencia artificial que llegarán a Zoom
La detección de deepfakes forma parte de un paquete de herramientas con el que Zoom busca concentrar controles de seguridad, cumplimiento y administración de inteligencia artificial.
La empresa sostiene que los agentes de IA ya interactúan con contenido de reuniones, datos de clientes y sistemas corporativos, por lo que las organizaciones necesitan saber qué información pueden consultar, generar o modificar.
Entre las novedades previstas figura Centralized AI Management, una consola para que los administradores tengan mayor visibilidad sobre los agentes y automatizaciones que operan dentro de una organización.
La herramienta permitirá establecer políticas a nivel de cuenta, revisar la actividad de la IA y ampliar los controles sobre los agentes creados por los usuarios. Zoom espera lanzarla también en diciembre de 2026.
La compañía además trabaja en barreras personalizadas para limitar la información que puede aparecer en los resultados generados por IA.
Estas reglas podrían impedir que datos financieros sensibles, conversaciones sobre competidores u otros contenidos definidos por cada empresa aparezcan en resúmenes o respuestas automáticas.
Permitirán exigir revisión humana antes de compartir determinados textos con clientes o excluir canales específicos del procesamiento mediante IA. Su llegada está prevista para el primer trimestre de 2027.
Otra de las funciones ya disponible es la integración de etiquetas de sensibilidad de Microsoft Purview con Zoom Meetings y Whiteboard.
El sistema sincroniza las clasificaciones utilizadas en Microsoft 365 para aplicar políticas de manejo de datos de manera más consistente dentro de Zoom.
Además, Zoom planea habilitar en enero de 2027 un administrador de cumplimiento para archivar resúmenes, notas y documentos generados por IA en My Notes y Zoom Canvas.
La medida apunta a sectores regulados que necesitan conservar y supervisar este tipo de contenido.
Cómo detectar un deepfake
Los deepfakes más convincentes no siempre se detectan a primera vista. El proyecto Detect Fakes, del Media Lab del Instituto Tecnológico de Massachusetts (MIT), recomienda observar detalles del rostro y verificar si mantienen coherencia con la iluminación, los movimientos y la apariencia general de la persona.
Uno de los primeros indicios puede estar en la piel. Conviene revisar si las mejillas y la frente se ven excesivamente lisas o, por el contrario, demasiado arrugadas.
El MIT aconseja prestar atención a las sombras alrededor de los ojos y las cejas, ya que los sistemas de inteligencia artificial pueden reproducir de forma imperfecta la física de la luz.
Los anteojos ofrecen otra pista. Si una persona mueve la cabeza, el reflejo de los lentes debería variar de manera natural.
Un brillo fijo, desproporcionado o con un ángulo extraño puede ser una señal de alerta. Lo mismo ocurre con el vello facial, los lunares y otros pequeños rasgos que la IA puede añadir o borrar sin lograr una integración convincente.
Por último, es importante mirar el parpadeo y la sincronía entre labios y voz. Un ritmo inusual al pestañear o movimientos labiales poco naturales pueden indicar que el video fue alterado.

articles.title: Vous allez acheter l'iPhone Duo ? En Apple Store, ça sera 2 maximum par personne
articles.text:
Vous pensiez en prendre un carton pour offrir à toute la famille à Noël ? Que nenni, si vous voulez retirer votre iPhone Duo en Apple Store, vous serez limité à 2 unités par personne.
Apple a instauré une limite de deux unités d'iPhone Duo par client pour les précommandes. Si l'on pouvait penser que cette restriction ne s'appliquerait qu'aux États-Unis, il n'en est rien. Le Japon, l'Espagne, la France et le Royaume-Uni font également partie des pays concernés. Résultat : impossible d'ajouter plus de deux smartphones au panier. Cette limitation est effective quelle que soit la configuration choisie.
Une mise en place récente et encore floue
On ne sait pas vraiment quand la marque à la pomme a décidé d'appliquer cette limite, mais le constructeur californien a laissé se faire les commandes dans un premier temps. Selon des témoignages sur Reddit, certains clients ont pu commander plus de 2 iPhone Duo dès le début des précommandes le 16 octobre dernier. Chose désormais impossible dans de nombreux pays.
Par ailleurs, on ignore si et comment Apple compte empêcher les revendeurs et scalpers de contourner cette limite en créant plusieurs comptes associés à différentes cartes de crédit.
Une demande qualifiée d'exceptionnelle par Apple
Cette décision de plafonner les achats n'est pas totalement inattendue. Apple avait déjà qualifié la demande pour l'iPhone Duo de "rien de moins qu'extraordinaire", une déclaration suivie peu après par un report des dates de livraison à 2027.
Les vérifications effectuées sur l'ensemble des boutiques en ligne confirment cette tendance qui va devoir demander pas mal de patience. En effet, une estimation de livraison désormais fixée au 25 janvier. Les clients n'ayant pas encore passé commande devront donc probablement patienter jusqu'à l'année prochaine.
Source : Engadget

articles.title: Novo Xbox pode chegar mais tarde e com preço mais alto • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Novo Xbox pode chegar mais tarde e com preço mais alto
Reportagem aponta lançamento só para 2028 e posicionamento mais premium para o Project Helix.
A Microsoft estaria planejando lançar um novo dispositivo portátil da linha Xbox no fim de 2027, enquanto o console de próxima geração, o Project Helix, seria lançado só no fim de 2028.
As informações são de uma reportagem da revista Fortune sobre os planos da atual liderança da divisão de games da empresa. Como já é de se esperar, o cronograma não foi confirmado oficialmente pela Microsoft.
Ainda assim, o suposto cronograma é compatível com parte das informações oficiais já divulgadas. A empresa já anunciou o Project Helix e informou que versões iniciais do hardware chegarão às desenvolvedoras em 2027, mas não revelou quando o produto será vendido aos consumidores.
Segundo a Fortune, a Microsoft trabalha atualmente com o fim de 2028 como janela para o lançamento comercial do console. A companhia também revelou que o hardware terá um novo chip personalizado da AMD e faz parte de uma estratégia de aproximar Xbox e PC como uma “família de dispositivos”. A ideia é reduzir as diferenças entre as duas plataformas e simplificar o desenvolvimento dos jogos.
Antes disso, a companhia teria planos de colocar no mercado um dispositivo portátil de nova geração no fim de 2027. Ainda não está claro se esse portátil seria fabricado diretamente pela Microsoft ou desenvolvido com uma parceira. A companhia já trabalhou com a Asus na linha ROG Xbox Ally, que combina hardware de PC com uma interface do Windows adaptada para jogos.
A reportagem também aponta o possível preço do console. Internamente, o Project Helix teria um valor projetado entre US$ 1.200 e US$ 1.800, cerca de R$ 6 mil e R$ 9 mil em conversão direta. A estimativa considera um cenário sem subsídio da Microsoft, o que significa que o preço final ainda pode ser menor.
A proposta não é totalmente inesperada. Desde antes do anúncio oficial, executivos da empresa indicavam que o próximo Xbox teria um posicionamento mais premium, já que deve oferecer avanços importantes em ray tracing e upscaling, além de rodar jogos de PC e continuar compatível com títulos de gerações anteriores.
Segundo a Fortune, a Microsoft também avalia uma reformulação do Game Pass, com uma estrutura mais flexível. O serviço poderia adotar planos por níveis, além de complementos pagos à parte pelo catálogo de jogos de console, o cloud gaming e o multiplayer. A ideia ainda estaria em desenvolvimento.
A estratégia acontece enquanto a CEO do Xbox, Asha Sharma, tenta ampliar o alcance da marca, reorganiza os estúdios e concentra investimentos nas principais franquias da companhia.

Alexander Isak scored the winner and appears to be moving back towards his clinical best, while Florian Wirtz created nine chances — the most since he joined the Reds last year. articles.title: Corsair Updates Sabre V3 Pro Line-Up With New PureVector Ergo, Carbon Fiber, and Magnesium Gaming Mice
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 20th 2026
Corsair Updates Sabre V3 Pro Line-Up With New PureVector Ergo, Carbon Fiber, and Magnesium Gaming Mice
Corsair has officially updated its Sabre V3 Pro mouse line-up with the PureVector series, a new partnership with Aimlabs that the brand claims can reduce aiming and correction time by as much as 33%. The PureVector nomenclature denotes a new tech developed by Corsair and Aimlabs that helps gamers optimize directional DPI to tune their mouse sensor for their own aiming style. The idea is that players would play through a calibration sequence inside Aimlabs while PureVector gathers data on their specific weak points and movement patterns, which the software will then use to build a custom DPI table based on movement direction, and then flash that directional DPI map to the mouse's firmware. 
The new tech comes preloaded on six new Sabre v3 Pro PureVector models, spanning three materials and two distinct shapes. The Sabre v3 Pro PureVector series offers both a symmetrical shape—measuring 122.9 (L) × 64.1 (W) × 38.8 mm (H)—which is based on the Sabre v2 shape that launched in late 2025, and a new right-handed ergonomic shape that measures in at 125 (L) × 67.5 (W) × 44 (H) mm. Both shapes are available from Corsair with a shell made of regular ABS (Ultralight model, $179.99), carbon fiber (CF model, $229.99), and magnesium (MG model, $199.99), with the latter featuring cutouts in the top of the shell for weight reduction.Internally, all of the Corsair Sabre v3 Pro PureVector mice are the same, packing a Corsair Marksman X sensor with 42,000 DPI peak sensitivity, 800 IPS tracking speed, and 70 G acceleration. The mice are also all capable of 8 kHz polling in both wired and 2.4 GHz wireless modes, and the built-in rechargeable battery has a claimed battery life of up to 200 hours at 1 kHz polling and 31 hours at 8 kHz polling rate. They also all use Corsair-tuned optical mouse switches for the left and right clicks. The mice are also all customizable in Corsair's Web Hub browser-based utility.The weights of the different versions of the Corsair Sabre v3 Pro PureVector mice are as follows:
- Sabre v3 Pro Pure Vector: 37 g
- Sabre v3 Pro PureVector Ergo: 41 g
- Sabre v3 Pro PureVector MG: 49 g
- Sabre v3 Pro PureVector MG Ergo: 55 g
- Sabre v3 Pro PureVector CF: 48 g
- Sabre v3 Pro PureVector CF Ergo: 54 g

articles.title: Fútbol Libre - Partidos de Fútbol y Canales Deportivos Online, es la búsqueda de Google que no aconsejamos
articles.text:
La búsqueda de “Fútbol Libre - Partidos de Fútbol y Canales Deportivos Online” se multiplicó en Google entre los aficionados que buscan ver gratis los cruces de la UEFA Champions League y la Copa Sudamericana. Sin embargo, esta consulta es una de las que los especialistas en seguridad digital desaconsejan con mayor insistencia.
Lejos de ofrecer una vía segura para disfrutar del torneo, la mayoría de los resultados asociados a ese nombre conducen a sitios clonados que ponen en riesgo la información personal y financiera de quien los visita.
El fenómeno responde a un patrón conocido. A medida que avanzan las fases decisivas de ambos certámenes, crece la presión por acceder a las transmisiones en tiempo real, y con ella, el tráfico hacia plataformas que prometen acceso instantáneo y sin costo. Esa demanda masiva es, precisamente, lo que explotan los operadores de estas páginas fraudulentas.
Por qué la búsqueda Fútbol Libre en Google es peligrosa
Durante los últimos meses, las autoridades y las grandes cadenas televisivas lograron bloquear buena parte de las páginas originales vinculadas a la red Fútbol Libre. La consecuencia directa es que, en la actualidad, casi todos los resultados que aparecen bajo ese nombre en los buscadores corresponden a clones maliciosos.
Estos sitios, en muchos casos, ya no están administrados por fanáticos del fútbol, sino por ciberdelincuentes que aprovechan el pico de visitas en los días de partido para lanzar campañas de estafa a gran escala.
El riesgo principal al ingresar a estas plataformas es la descarga forzada de extensiones o archivos APK. Bajo la excusa de mejorar la calidad de la transmisión, muchas páginas solicitan instalar programas o aplicaciones externas que en realidad contienen troyanos, virus espía o malware bancario capaces de robar credenciales y vaciar cuentas.
A esto se suma el peligro de aceptar permisos de notificación, que exponen al dispositivo a una avalancha de publicidad engañosa y mensajes de phishing diseñados para capturar contraseñas y datos sensibles.
También existen scripts ocultos para minado de criptomonedas: un clic en un falso botón de reproducción puede activar procesos que usan el hardware del teléfono o la computadora sin autorización, lo que sobrecalienta el equipo y acorta su vida útil.
En síntesis, buscar Fútbol Libre en Google para ver partidos de la UEFA Champions League o de la Copa Sudamericana expone al usuario a instalaciones de malware, robo de credenciales bancarias y minado oculto de criptomonedas, además de una transmisión de baja calidad con retrasos de hasta dos minutos respecto a las señales oficiales.
Fallas técnicas y tácticas de engaño en los sitios piratas
Más allá del riesgo informático, la experiencia de ver fútbol a través de estas plataformas piratas tiene fallas evidentes. Las transmisiones de Fútbol Libre suelen presentar un retraso de señal de hasta dos minutos respecto a las opciones legales, lo que implica spoilers de goles y jugadas clave para quienes siguen el resultado por otros medios.
A esto se agregan las caídas constantes del servicio en los momentos de mayor tensión del partido, producto de la sobrecarga de servidores clandestinos que no están preparados para sostener el tráfico de un encuentro decisivo. La calidad de imagen suele ser baja y las interrupciones, frecuentes, justo en los instantes donde más importa no perder la transmisión.
Los clones de Fútbol Libre y de plataformas similares se multiplican cada día y cambian de dominio de forma constante para evadir los bloqueos de las autoridades. Están diseñados para parecer legítimos y captar la urgencia de quienes buscan ver el partido a cualquier costo.
Entre las tácticas más frecuentes que utilizan estos sitios se encuentran los formularios falsos de “registro gratuito” que capturan datos bancarios, los anuncios que simulan ser controles del reproductor de video y redirigen a páginas de estafa, y las promociones falsas que ofrecen premios o acceso VIP a cambio de información personal.
Alternativas oficiales para ver los partidos de la Champions League y la Sudamericana
Frente a estos riesgos, la recomendación de los especialistas es recurrir a plataformas legales y autorizadas para seguir el torneo. Para los partidos de la UEFA Champions League o de la Copa Sudamericana existen varias opciones verificadas.
Entre ellas se cuentan los canales de televisión autorizados en cada país, la señal de DSports junto con su plataforma de streaming oficial DGO, y las señales abiertas y aplicaciones oficiales disponibles en distintos territorios.
Estas alternativas garantizan una experiencia estable, sin malware ni fraudes asociados, y protegen tanto los datos personales como la información financiera del usuario durante toda la transmisión.
Recomendaciones para cuidar tus datos al ver fútbol online
Para reducir el riesgo de caer en una estafa digital durante la temporada de partidos decisivos, los especialistas recomiendan evitar la descarga de archivos o extensiones fuera de las tiendas oficiales de aplicaciones.
También sugieren verificar siempre que la URL del sitio comience por “https” y pertenezca a una entidad reconocida, mantener actualizado el dispositivo con soluciones de seguridad activas para bloquear amenazas, y evitar compartir datos sensibles en plataformas que no cuenten con verificación.
Buscar Fútbol Libre en Google puede parecer una solución rápida para ver partidos de la UEFA Champions League o de la Copa Sudamericana, pero es una de las formas más sencillas de exponerse a fraudes y robo de datos financieros. Apostar por los servicios oficiales continúa siendo la única manera de disfrutar el torneo sin comprometer la seguridad digital.

articles.title: Google Chrome vai exibir novo alerta para sites suspeitos • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Google Chrome vai exibir novo alerta para sites suspeitos
Navegador usa Gemini para identificar possíveis golpes e adiciona proteção contra comandos maliciosos.
O Google anunciou nesta terça-feira (20/10) uma nova camada de alerta no Chrome para páginas suspeitas. Em vez de exibir a tradicional tela vermelha usada para sites classificados como perigosos, o navegador poderá mostrar primeiro um pop-up com o aviso de que aquela página “não parece certa”.
A mudança estará disponível para usuários do modo de Proteção Avançada do Safe Browsing. Segundo o Google, o Chrome também usará modelos do Gemini executados na nuvem para analisar possíveis golpes oe ganhou uma proteção específica contra ataques do tipo ClickFix.
As ferramentas fazem parte do modo Proteção Avançada do Safe Browsing. A configuração pode ser ativada nas opções de privacidade e segurança do Chrome, permitindo ao navegador enviar informações ao Google para verificar páginas, downloads e extensões.
A nova classificação segue a lógica adotada pelo Google em downloads de arquivos há dois anos. Páginas com indícios de comportamento enganoso, mas que ainda não receberam classificação de página maliciosa, passam a receber o rótulo de site suspeito.
Nesse caso, o Chrome escurece a página e exibe uma janela com a mensagem “Este site não parece certo”. O usuário pode voltar ou seguir em frente. Já os sites perigosos continuam sendo bloqueados através de uma tela cheia vermelha. A classificação é usada para páginas de maior risco, incluindo as associadas a golpes de phishing, por exemplo.
Segundo Jasika Bawa, gerente de produto do Chrome, a mudança permite diferenciar páginas para as quais o sistema ainda não atribui o mesmo nível de confiança. Dessa forma, o Google amplia os avisos sem bloquear completamente a navegação em todos os casos considerados duvidosos.
O Chrome também está ampliando o uso do Gemini para identificar golpes durante a navegação. No ano passado, o Google introduziu um modelo executado localmente em aparelhos compatíveis para detectar páginas que simulavam serviços de suporte técnico.
Agora, parte da análise poderá ser realizada pelos servidores da empresa. A mudança, segundo o Google, permite detectar outros tipos de fraude, incluindo páginas que simulam alertas de antivírus e atualizações falsas do próprio navegador.
O sistema analisa elementos como a marca que a página afirma representar, o conteúdo exibido e sinais de risco, combinando-os a informações como a reputação do endereço. De acordo com o Google, o processamento é temporário: os textos não são mantidos em registros nem são usados no treinamento de modelos de IA.
Outra novidade é a identificação de prompts usados em ataques conhecidos como ClickFix. Neles, o usuário é instruído a copiar comandos para ferramentas como PowerShell ou o Prompt de Comando do Windows em que malwares podem ser baixados.
Segundo o Google, o navegador remove informações pessoais da área de transferência antes de consultar o Safe Browsing e, caso detecte risco, exibe um alerta antes que o comando seja utilizado.

articles.title: SpaceX's stock soars as Elon Musk reveals crushing earnings and revenue beat - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
SpaceX’s stock soars as Elon Musk reveals crushing earnings and revenue beat
Shares of Space Exploration Technologies Corp., Elon Musk’s rocket developer and artificial intelligence company, gained more than 8% in late trading today after posting earnings results that revealed the strong momentum of its AI business.
The company, better known as SpaceX, reported third-quarter earnings before certain costs such as stock compensation of 45 cents per share, crushing Wall Street’s forecast of 13 cents, while revenue soared 161% from a year earlier, to $14.6 billion, surpassing the $12.72 billion target with ease. That helped SpaceX to deliver a first-ever profit, with net income coming to $4.4 billion to reverse a loss of $1.1 billion in the same period one year earlier.
SpaceX also reported income from operations of $2.8 billion, compared with a loss of $273 million a year ago. Adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization came to $8.8 billion, up 306%, while the company’s diluted income per share was 35 cents, up from a loss of 36 cents last year.
The company livestreamed its earnings call on its social media platform X, formerly Twitter, and it was a must-see for fans of Musk, who appeared alongside Chief Operating Officer Gwynne Shotwell and Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnson. The livestream began in dramatic fashion, with a video recap of the most recent Starship flight and orchestral music playing in the background.
It followed by a simulation of the company’s next upcoming flight, during which it will use a huge mechanical arm to try and grab both the rocket’s booster and the actual ship. The company has promised it will be a “profound technology milestone in the history of civilization and consciousness.”
The livestream then switched to a cinematic view of SpaceX’s products, before focusing on the three executives seated at a table in a room at the company’s Starlink factory in Bastrop, Texas.
“In order to understand the nature of the universe and all these fundamental questions, we must expand the scope of consciousness,” Musk said in a recording played against a video background of space and the moon. The event looked more like the opening of a science-fiction movie than a corporate earnings report.
Q3 2026 Financial and Operational Results https://t.co/Qrb0qeVG15
— SpaceX (@SpaceX) October 20, 2026
With the dramatic visuals out of the way, Musk got down to business, and quickly generated excitement when he stressed that he thinks a merger between SpaceX and Tesla Inc., his electric vehicle company, would be a “good idea.” He revealed the boards of both companies have created a special committee to examine the feasibility of a merger.
SpaceX is best known for its rocket-powered spacelift capability, but its most profitable business by far is Starlink, the satellite-based internet connectivity division, so those were some of the more interesting numbers that investors wanted to hear about. And what Musk said surely pleased them, as he revealed that Starlink’s subscriber base had grown to 13.6 million at the end of the quarter, up from 12 million in the prior period.
Meanwhile, Starlink’s total connectivity revenue soared to $5.25 billion in the quarter, up 69% from the $3.1 billion in recorded a year earlier and ahead of the Street’s forecast of $4.84 billion. Starlink’s consumer revenue came to $3.12 billion, while enterprise and government customers contributed $2.13 billion to the total.
SpaceX is also an AI company following its acquisition of xAI earlier this year. xAI is Musk’s AI startup, the developer of the chatbot Grok, and it also owns the X social media platform. XAI is now the company’s largest business, with revenue soaring to $7.56 billion in the quarter, up from just $813 million one year ago. Wall Street analysts had been looking for sales of just $6.47 billion there. The business is likely to get bigger in future too, for SpaceX wrapped up its $60 billion acquisition of the AI coding startup Cursor during the quarter.
The health of SpaceX’s AI business sparked a jump in the shares of companies such as Nvidia Corp. and Intel Corp., up 2% and 3% respectively, as well as neocloud providers like CoreWeave Inc. and Nebius Group N.V., which gained 5% and 6%, respectively.
In the video, Musk laid out some ambitious goals for increasing the company’s data center capacity, saying he wants to grow it to 20 gigawatts by the end of 2027, up from just 1.7 gigawatts today. Though many investors have raised concerns about the sustainability of compute demand, SpaceX’s numbers and plans suggest that Musk does not feel the same way. On the contrary, Musk said SpaceX has been “hounded relentlessly by every hyperscaler and dozens of smaller companies to rent more of our compute.”
Musk also said that compute prices have increased to a point where the company can generate a return on its data center investments within 12 months, and he believes that this window could shorten to just six months by this time next year. But such a payback will be necessary, for the company revealed bold ambitions to grow its capital expenditure over the next year. SpaceX is planning to spend between $35 billion and $40 billion on data center infrastructure in the current quarter, up from $19.6 billion spent in the previous quarter.
Moving on to the forecast, Johnson took over, saying that the company is on track to hit a $100 billion annual recurring revenue run rate by the end of the year. That number could grow to as much as $500 billion to $1 trillion by the end of 2027, he said, thanks in part to the growing adoption of the company’s chatbot Grok.
For the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027, SpaceX is targeting revenue of between $33 billion and $37 billion, well ahead of the Street’s estimate of $22 billion.

articles.title: Este robot puede cambiar los cuatro neumáticos sin desmontar las llantas en media hora
articles.text:
Cambiar los neumáticos de un coche es una de esas tareas que se repiten a diario en los talleres y cuyo procedimiento apenas ha cambiado en décadas: elevar el vehículo, retirar cada rueda y llevarla a una desmontadora para poder sacar la cubierta de la llanta. La empresa estadounidense Automated Tire quiere cambiar esa rutina con un robot que trabaja directamente sobre las ruedas, sin necesidad de desmontarlas del coche.
Trabajo directo sobre el eje. El robot de Automated Tire se llama SmartBay y es capaz de hacer la tarea directamente sobre el eje, sin tener que quitar las ruedas como hasta ahora, de hecho, todo se hace con el coche colocado en el elevador. Primero unos brazos mecánicos se colocan sobre las dos ruedas de un mismo eje a la vez y retiran los dos neumáticos de forma simultánea, dejando la llanta en su sitio. Después colocan la cubierta nueva y realizan el alineado de la dirección. En total, el cambio de los cuatro neumáticos con la máquina lleva unos 30 minutos.
Los humanos siguen haciendo falta. Aunque el proceso reduce el esfuerzo físico, sigue haciendo falta que un mecánico opere el robot. El operario debe subir el coche a la altura necesaria, retirar los neumáticos del robot y colocar los nuevos con el lubricante necesario.
A partir de ese punto, el sistema retoma el control apoyado en algoritmos de IA para montar las cubiertas y equilibrar el conjunto. El mecanismo se encarga incluso de fijar los contrapesos adecuados en cada llanta.
Sí, pero. Cambiar los cuatro neumáticos en media hora no supone necesariamente una mejora frente a un mecánico experimentado. La principal ventaja está en la capacidad de trabajo: Automated Tire sostiene que un solo operario puede supervisar hasta tres robots al mismo tiempo.
El trabajador puede hacer las tareas manuales de un robot mientras los otros hacen la parte automatizada del montaje o la calibración. De esta forma, el negocio logra asumir más cambios de ruedas al día sin necesidad de contratar más personal. Al final, es una forma de sustituir empleados por máquinas, sólo que no todos los empleados.
Un alquiler para grandes volúmenes. Automated Tire no vende la máquina, la alquila a los talleres por 4.900 dólares al mes. Es una inversión considerable que difícilmente encajará en un pequeño taller. Su solución más orientada a talleres con un gran volumen de cambios de neumáticos como centros especializados.

articles.title: En tête de notre comparatif, les AirPods Pro 3 tombent à 209€ chez Amazon
articles.text:
Amazon affiche les AirPods Pro 3 à 209 € depuis le 15 octobre, quand Boulanger, la Fnac et Darty restent autour de 249 €. Notre test a salué leur réduction de bruit, mais relevé un son moins équilibré que sur la génération précédente et une connectivité toujours fermée à Android.
Arrivés à l’automne 2025, les AirPods Pro 3 sont les écouteurs à réduction de bruit haut de gamme d’Apple. Ils gardent la puce H2 des AirPods Pro 2, mais adoptent une canule plus marquée, un capteur de fréquence cardiaque et une certification IP57. Amazon les propose à 209 € au lieu de 249 €, soit 40 € de moins que chez Boulanger et 40,99 € sous la Fnac et Darty, à 249,99 €. Ce tarif tient depuis le 15 octobre. L’offre vise d’abord les utilisateurs d’iPhone, les seuls à profiter de l’ensemble de leurs fonctions.
Les AirPods Pro 3 passent à 209 € au lieu de 249 € chez Amazon, un écart que Boulanger, la Fnac et Darty n’ont pas suivi pour l’instant.
Pourquoi choisir les AirPods Pro 3 ?
- Une réduction de bruit encore plus poussée : Dans notre test, l’atténuation démarre dès les basses et reste stable jusqu’aux haut-médiums, un cran au-dessus des AirPods Pro 2. Les nouveaux embouts filtrent aussi mieux les conversations voisines.
- Un capteur cardiaque précis : Les écouteurs mesurent votre fréquence cardiaque pendant l’effort, avec une courbe qui suivait de près notre ceinture cardio. Les données restent toutefois cantonnées à l’app Santé.
- Plus d’autonomie par charge : Apple annonce 8 h d’écoute avec réduction de bruit, et nous avons mesuré un peu plus de 8 h 20. De quoi tenir un long trajet sans repasser par le boîtier.
Transports, sport et appels : ce qu’ils changent au quotidien
Le premier terrain des AirPods Pro 3 reste les transports. Leur format plus intra-auriculaire renforce l’isolation passive sur les fréquences de la voix, ce qui aide à s’isoler dans une rame bondée ou un open space. La certification IP57, étendue au boîtier, et la résistance à la transpiration les rendent plus adaptés au sport, où le capteur cardiaque prend son sens. En appel, la voix reste naturelle au calme et mieux préservée qu’avant dans le bruit, sans miracle.
Comme le détaille notre test des AirPods Pro 3, ces écouteurs ne déploient leur potentiel qu’avec un iPhone : audio adaptatif, détection des conversations, test auditif, audio spatial. Sur Android, ni niveau de batterie ni vrai multipoint, et l’achat perd l’essentiel de son intérêt. La nouvelle canule divise aussi : la tenue est plus ferme, mais une légère pression à l’entrée du conduit peut gêner sur de longues sessions comme à l’effort. Si vous trouviez les AirPods Pro 2 parfaitement confortables, le changement mérite réflexion.
Sony WF-1000XM6, AirPods 4 : où se situent les AirPods Pro 3
Dans notre comparatif des meilleurs écouteurs sans fil, les AirPods Pro 3 occupent la première place, avec une note de 9/10. Les Sony WF-1000XM6, notés 9/10 eux aussi, les devancent sur la qualité audio et la connectivité, avec multipoint, LDAC et LE Audio, un vrai atout hors de l’écosystème Apple. Si les embouts vous gênent, les AirPods 4 avec réduction de bruit offrent un format ouvert, au prix d’une atténuation moins efficace sur les très basses fréquences. Pour un utilisateur d’iPhone, les AirPods Pro 3 restent le choix le plus cohérent.
✅ Les points forts
- Réduction de bruit et mode Transparence de très haut niveau
- Capteur de fréquence cardiaque précis à l’effort
- Plus de 8 h d’écoute mesurées avec réduction de bruit
- Écouteurs et boîtier certifiés IP57
- Fonctions d’audition bien intégrées à iOS 26
❌ Les limites
- Son plus démonstratif, moins équilibré que sur les AirPods Pro 2
- Format plus intrusif, confort moins universel
- Boîtier limité à deux recharges complètes
- Ni vrai multipoint ni LE Audio, fonctions bridées hors iPhone
Affichés à 209 € depuis le 15 octobre sur Amazon, les AirPods Pro 3 restent 40 € sous le prix pratiqué chez Boulanger.
À 209 €, les AirPods Pro 3 coûtent 40 € de moins que chez Boulanger, la Fnac ou Darty, pour des écouteurs que nous plaçons en tête de notre sélection. La baisse est plus mesurée face au prix moyen relevé sur Amazon, 221,99 € selon camelcamelcamel : c’est un palier bas qui tient depuis le 15 octobre, pas une chute spectaculaire. Pour un utilisateur d’iPhone qui veut s’isoler dans les transports et suivre son rythme cardiaque à l’effort sans montre, l’offre tombe juste.
Les possesseurs d’AirPods Pro 2 n’ont en revanche aucune urgence : le son a perdu en équilibre, le boîtier en endurance, et le gain se joue surtout sur l’isolation et le capteur cardiaque. Sur Android, les Sony WF-1000XM6 répondent mieux à vos besoins. Et si les embouts intra vous rebutent, les AirPods 4 avec réduction de bruit sont la piste à explorer avant de vous décider.

articles.title: Zoom's new Unified Context Layer unlocks all of your company's complex conversations and video calls for AI agents to use
articles.text:
Zoom's new Unified Context Layer unlocks all of your company's complex conversations and video calls for AI agents to use
UCL tackles one of the biggest data siloes companies face
- Zoom is packaging up conversations and calls into a Unified Context Layer
- APIs mean third-party AI agents can get direct access to this source of data
- Humans can now spend less time explaining context to AI agents
In recognition that increasingly siloed and complex systems are making it harder for companies to keep track of all their data, making it difficult to deploy effective AI on top of existing tech stacks, Zoom has launched its Unified Context Layer (UCL).
UCL works by bringing together meeting conversations, chats, documents and other business data into one connected system, which it hopes will make it easier for AI agents to work across.
This marks an important step in the company's much broader transition from the video conferencing platform we grew to love during the now-distant pandemic to a full productivity suite that spans both human and agentic users.
Zoom's Unified Context Layer
"This new layer brings together conversations with near real-time activity across Zoom and connected third-party applications, giving people and AI agents access to business context that might otherwise be lost or siloed," the company said in an announcement.
But in a world of increasing interoperability, the company is also adding new APIs to allow external AI tools to query its Unified Context Layer directly, which means ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Muse and other AI agents can see straight into the core data that Zoom holds.
The biggest impact is on productivity, where human workers will need to spend far less time fetching different parts of context to give an AI agent the best chances of success.
Of course, Zoom isn't the first platform to be introducing a Unified Context Layer, but being that the software is still primarily used for communications both within organizations and with external clients, Zoom's UCL should be able to unlock some pretty serious unstructured data for future AI agents.

With Zoom now betting on conversations as a vastly underused source of intelligence, its early adoption of a UCL should play an integral role both in its own roadmap, but also how enterprises benefit from agentic AI on the whole.

articles.title: AMD and Microsoft Bring FSR 4.1 to Xbox Series X|S, FSR Diamond Teased for Project Helix
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 20th 2026
AMD and Microsoft Bring FSR 4.1 to Xbox Series X|S, FSR Diamond Teased for Project Helix
AMD and Microsoft have confirmed that FSR Upscaling 4.1 is coming to the Xbox Series X and Series S. The news came in an AMD video presentation led by Jack Huynh, joined by Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet and ASUS. The ROG Xbox Ally handhelds are getting it too, and it looks like they will be first in line, while the consoles are only listed as "coming soon." Neither company has shared a release date or a list of supported games. Both consoles use RDNA 2 graphics, the same architecture as the Radeon RX 6000 series, which AMD also announced FSR 4.1 for today, well ahead of the early 2027 target it set in May. Here's what Van Vliet said:
With FSR 4.1 coming to Xbox. Now, we've worked very closely with AMD to optimize this technology, giving developers another powerful tool for great performance and visual quality for players. Now, whether you're playing on an Xbox Ally handheld, as well as coming soon to Xbox Series X and Series S consoles. And this is just the beginning. Our teams are continuing to work together across hardware and software, and there's even more ahead with Project Helix, leveraging FSR Diamond to power what comes next.
The handheld side is a bit murkier. AMD said earlier this month that a lighter FSR model for APUs would arrive by the end of 2026, and it has reportedly listed both the Ryzen Z2 Extreme and Z2 A as targets. However, one report claims the base ROG Xbox Ally is left out, so owners are advised to wait for ASUS's driver update before assuming anything. Van Vliet also teased Project Helix, Microsoft's next-gen Xbox, which will use FSR Diamond with ML-based upscaling and multi-frame generation. Sony recently announced its own QSSR upscaler for the base PS5. The Series S probably stands to gain the most here, though a lot depends on how many developers actually adopt it.
Source:
				AMD			
	
	
	
		
	
		
16 Comments on AMD and Microsoft Bring FSR 4.1 to Xbox Series X|S, FSR Diamond Teased for Project Helix
RDNA 1-2-3-3.5 really paying for not having that RDNA 4 AI hardware FSR 4.x needs to run natively it seems. At least it can run, which wasn't the case not long ago.
For reference, the internal resolution is 50% that of native with Performance upscaling, for a 2x scale factor, whereas with Quality you're at 67% and 1.5x. Balanced is 59% 1.7x. UItra Quality is 77% 1.3x. Quality generally has a 20-30% performance bonus, with Performance being up to 70% bonus FPS due to literally rendering half of native. I'm honestly shocked that the raw FPS before frame gen on FSR 4.1 Performance is in the ~30 FPS range on hardware as on-paper powerful as an XSX. That's 540p internal resolution assuming output is 1080p, and it's only just holding ~30 FPS. Damn.
Can definitely see why that lighter model is required for handhelds. Lets hope that even with a cut down model the IQ improvements are still as notable as the jump from (typically not worth using as it's impossible to ignore the IQ issues) FSR 1-3.x to FSR 4.x (worth using and on par with DLSS 3.x). The Switch 2 had a pretty good result even with cut-down DLSS on obsolete handheld hardware, so in theory, it's possible. Fingers crossed. If not, at least there's still Intel XeSS, which even in compatibility mode is still much better than FSR 1-3.x, and works pretty well on those handhelds.
RDNA 4/5 handheld/console chips can't come soon enough, even if the raw raster is barely improved, these upscalers are essential in modern games, and struggling to hit 30 FPS before FG with the upscaler almost as low as it can go, internal resolution wise, isn't good.
Hey, at least MS/Sony are trying to eke out every last bit of oomph these consoles have. Kudos there.
Hopefully they'll implement it correctly and do a better comparison in the future. I'm no console user anymore, but still interested in the market.
Did you expect anything different? FSR 4.x was known to be heavier than FSR 3.x and would therefore yield lower performance on RDNA2 hardware. The question was simply whether FSR 4.x on performance/balanced settings would offer a better, more stable image compared to FSR 3.x on quality. And that was the whole point of releasing FSR 4.x for RDNA2 cards: to give the user more options—options that might offer image quality improvements that FSR 3.x couldn't deliver. In no way were we expecting higher performance out of RDNA2.
As has been said, this isn't tested on the base PS5 with its RDNA 1.5 esque GPU, this is full RDNA 2 on a fairly powerful config on the series X. Sure, it's not a PS5 Pro with a newer arch, but two quality levels? Damn.
While we knew it's a heavy model especially if the dedicated hardware isn't present (why wasnt it AMD/Xbox/Sony, you had both Turing and Ampere to learn from by the time the console chips shipped), I am quite surprised that the move from Quality to Performance is necessary to end up roughly at the same output FPS (considering the 9 improvement is after frame gen, the actual improvement is roughly half that). A whole 5 FPS gained at ~25 vs 30 base FPS while jumping down two quality settings is pretty nuts to me.
Anyway. Glad I've not really recommended any console besides the Switch 2 and PS5 Pro when I've been asked by friends what to pick if not going PC. Besides being roughly 2x the performance GPU wise of the base PS5, not being stuck in RDNA 1/2 hell is worth the premium.
Now, concerning the absence of corresponding hardware in RDNA 1/2 implementations that existed in Nvidia's GPUs, I imagine Nvidia didn't design that hardware in a month—let alone test it and build software and drivers for it. AMD would needed even more time, being something new to them. And of course, additional hardware means extra cost and potentially higher power consumption. With consoles being 6 years on the market already, the fact that the need for such hardware surfaced likely somewhere in their 4th, 5th, or 6th year of life suggests that choosing not to complicate the architecture with extra hardware—which would have increased both complexity and cost—was probably the right call.
Going from 25 fps to 30 fps is a 20% increase. Sounds good to me, maybe even better than good.
As for the last point, since you're a PC user who is deeply immersed in technology and its news, and since you're a PC enthusiast who finds themselves caring about things like "what technology is being used here", I think the wisest choice is to go for hardware that won't feel obsolete to you, because psychologically it won't sit well with you. It's like buying an RX 6950 today. It might still perform very well in games, but the moment you get it in your hands, you've already built a mental list of everything it can't do. This is a classic case of "ignorance is bliss".
Nvidia either refused to do dieshrinks or kept charging as much as before, harming Microsoft's first Xbox generation. There may have been technological dissatisfaction issues too (Sony dropped Nvidia after PS3 over those a generation later).You realize Xbox was Microsoft console? It was neither Nvidia console, nor joint Nvidia-MS project where Nvidia was in place to push some ideas or vision and be in position to mind alleged "enshitifications" or whatever. They were asked (and paid) to supply a GPU and a chipset.
This is the result of that decision making by both AMD/MS, and predictable (many people here on TPU have been talking about this for years). MS/Sony want to add non-shit upscalers, and it's a struggle, because to get good image quality you need AI, and if you need AI, it's going to be slow on anything without (decent) dedicated AI hardware. So, Pre RDNA 4 or Pre Turing. One of those debuted in 2018, the other in 2025. If you are making a console in 2019, which do you pick?
Obviously a last gen/two generation old combo you can get cheaply from AMD, right? Well here we are. 20-30 base FPS after upscaling from 540p. What can you do with that? Very little. They've boxed themselves in. Can't even sell the consoles cheaply to make up for it because of that same AI train they missed the boat on.
Only good thing I can say about the non-PS5P consoles is at least they weren't using the *shudder* Jaguar cores for CPU. That decision set back game dev what, 5 years? The Zen 2 cores in consoles are at least workable, even in 2026.
The question now becomes how many years using RDNA 1/2 GPU IP in the current gen of consoles set back the game dev industry.
Now we're at the point where the rumours are "next xbox is PC with UDNA 5", so, decent GPU/AI IP, presumably. Downside? ~1.5-2k "console". What's the alternative? PS5P (if you can find), or 20-25 FPS last gen console.
Good luck John Consumer, definitely some great choices set before you. Hope you built a PC a year ago, though you probably didn't.Given the GPU architecture the base PS5 and both XBOXes use, the only way to get both decent upscaling and decent performance is to run it on PS5P, it seems. Sony released a worse IQ and lighter upscaler for the base PS5 recently IIRC, to throw them a bone.

articles.title: El fin de la libreta de bocetos: la evolución tecnológica que jubilaría al papel en el diseño gráfico
articles.text:
El olor a grafito y el sonido de las hojas al pasar solían ser la banda sonora inconfundible de cualquier estudio de diseño. Durante décadas, las mesas de los creativos estuvieron dominadas por montañas de libretas, marcadores desgastados, libretas de recortes y gomas de borrar.
Era un ecosistema enteramente táctil, nostálgico, pero también físicamente limitante y poco amigable con la preservación del medio ambiente. Hoy, ese paisaje de papelería abarrotada empieza a desvanecerse silenciosamente para dar paso a escritorios despejados, donde un solo rectángulo de cristal encierra las herramientas de todo un taller.
La diseñadora gráfica peruana, Abril Belmonte, en declaraciones a Infobae, demostró ser consciente de esta realidad. Ya no busca su viejo cuaderno cuando llega la inspiración: ahora sus manos se deslizan sobre una pantalla con un lápiz digital que no requiere tajador. Aunque la celulosa ha sido reemplazada por luz dinámica, la fricción, el flujo de la idea y el nacimiento del trazo siguen intactos.
Esta transformación está impulsada por el desarrollo de tabletas de gama alta orientadas a la creatividad y la productividad. Dispositivos como la Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra buscan replicar la precisión del soporte físico mediante pantallas de bajo grosor, integración de estilete y funciones de inteligencia artificial. De este modo, la transición del formato impreso al digital se plantea como una optimización del flujo de trabajo.
La simulación del trazo físico: sensación táctil y ergonomía
El mayor reto de la digitalización siempre ha sido convencer a la memoria muscular de los artistas. Sin embargo, el desarrollo del lápiz óptico ha logrado replicar con exactitud el comportamiento de las herramientas tradicionales.
“Para mí, se siente muy similar a dibujar sobre una hoja de papel. Lo que más me gusta es la sensibilidad a la presión del S Pen de Samsung: cuando presionas más, el trazo sale más oscuro y grueso, y cuando lo haces más suave, se vuelve más fino”, detalla Abril Belmonte.
Técnicamente, el S Pen cuenta con un diseño ergonómico que ofrece una entrada precisa e intuitiva para tomar notas y esbozar conceptos sin esfuerzo. “Dibujar directamente con el S Pen es mucho más intuitivo que hacerlo con un mouse, porque tienes un control más directo sobre cada trazo”, añade la diseñadora.
Este nivel de detalle se potencia en aplicaciones de nivel profesional como Clip Studio Paint —que ahora llega con herramientas de pintura de precisión y beneficios exclusivos en el ecosistema—, permitiendo que el lienzo digital reaccione de la misma forma que un papel de alto gramaje absorbería la tinta.
Sostenibilidad y digitalización: de la libreta al ecosistema ecológico
Más allá de la experiencia de dibujo, la transición busca reducir la dependencia de insumos físicos. Migrar a un formato completamente digital transforma el flujo de trabajo, eliminando la necesidad de arrumar decenas de cuadernos a lo largo del año.
“Personalmente, prefiero bocetar directamente en la tablet porque es súper ligera y la llevo a todos lados. Además, tener nuestros proyectos digitalizados nos permite compartir las ideas rápidamente con el equipo”, afirma Belmonte.
Este nivel de portabilidad se apoya en un diseño de ingeniería delgado, con apenas 5,1 milímetros de grosor en su versión tope de gama. El reemplazo del papel se completa a través de plataformas nativas como Samsung Notes y herramientas de Galaxy AI, como Note Assist.
Autonomía y colaboración en cualquier lugar
El entorno de una agencia exige respuestas rápidas y soluciones integrales. Para Belmonte, la capacidad de avanzar con agilidad en proyectos complejos de marcas, empaques e ilustraciones directamente desde una tablet portátil, sin estar atada a una computadora de escritorio, es importante para el ritmo de Enigma Brand Studio.
Este rendimiento ininterrumpido en exteriores o reuniones se sostiene sobre especificaciones técnicas de vanguardia. La nueva serie de tablets incorpora resistencia al agua y al polvo con certificación IP68, lo que permite bocetar al aire libre o en ambientes exigentes sin temor a accidentes.
A nivel de autonomía, los dispositivos han sido diseñados para largas jornadas de inspiración lejos de un enchufe, ofreciendo baterías masivas que brindan hasta 23 horas de uso continuo en su modelo de 14,6 pulgadas y 21 horas en la versión Plus.
Cuando el ritmo de trabajo exige energía, la batería pasa del 0% al 100% en aproximadamente 95 minutos. Todo esto es impulsado por un procesador de 3 nanómetros que aumenta la capacidad de la CPU y GPU, refrigerado por una cámara de vapor 3D de nuevo diseño para que, al renderizar proyectos complejos bajo el brillo de 1.600 nits de su pantalla Dynamic AMOLED 2X, el equipo mantenga un rendimiento óptimo sin sobrecalentarse.

articles.title: Elon Musk throttled Starlink in embattled Ukraine - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Elon Musk throttled Starlink in embattled Ukraine
Elon Musk last week reportedly ordered the slowdown of Starlink technology in Ukraine, hindering the country’s efforts to stave off Russian attacks, according to an article today by the Wall Street Journal.
Musk reportedly capped the speeds of the military-grade version of the Starlink satellite-based network, Starshield. Ukrainian officials said the decision effectively disabled some of its offensive and interceptor drones and left it open to Russian missile attacks against major cities, including Kyiv.
The Journal, speaking to unnamed U.S. officials familiar with the matter, said the slowdown started on Oct. 14 though there is some confusion as to who was informed at the White House. Musk reportedly consulted senior officials in the administration and Trump himself, although another source has said the White House wasn’t consulted at all.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has since aired concern blaming both the U.S. and Musk’s SpaceX for the problems that continued all through last week. Musk denied having any influence on the throttling, writing on X, “Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the U.S. government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS.”
He added that “Starlink is a commercial service owned and controlled by SpaceX. Usage of Starlink is limited to civilian or defensive activities and cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company.”
In what seems like a hot-potato situation, Reuters last week reported that the decision came from the White House but Trump later denied that he or Musk had any involvement in the matter. “I don’t know if it was anybody, because it wasn’t me and I don’t think it was Elon,” he said on Friday to reporters outside the White House.
President Zelensky disagreed, stating, “The message came from government. I don’t know from whom, what cabinet, and et cetera.” He was certain the order came from the U.S government and, “technically, SpaceX did it.”
Secretary of State Marco Rubio today attempted to clear up the matter, telling reporters that Ukrainians dying because of a decision to deny the Ukrainian military American technology is “scandalous.” Rubio ventured that the blackout was a “technical matter” and not “any sort of U.S. directive.”
Trump has come heavy attack recently for what The Atlantic called delivering a “staggering one-two punch” to Ukraine after criticizing Zelensky, reportedly agreeing to the Starlink slowdown, and agreeing a deal Russian leader Vladimir Putin to import Russian diesel fuel into the U.S. The New York Times wrote that Trump has “gone so far in putting Russia’s interests ahead of Ukraine’s security.”

articles.title: iPhone Duo : sa batterie face aux autres iPhone, voici ce que ça donne
articles.text:
La capacité de la batterie de l’iPhone Duo était l’une des dernières inconnues du smartphone pliant d’Apple. Un document réglementaire déposé en Europe au moment des précommandes vient d’y répondre : 4 883 mAh, répartis sur deux cellules distinctes.
Dès l’ouverture des précommandes, Apple a transmis aux autorités européennes un document officiel détaillant la configuration interne de la batterie. Le total de 4 883 mAh provient de deux cellules : une de 2 962 mAh et une de 1 921 mAh. Ce chiffre place l’iPhone Duo exactement entre l’iPhone 18 Pro et l’iPhone 18 Pro Max.
L’iPhone Duo se place juste derrière les modèles Pro Max
Le Duo devance largement la majorité des iPhone récents. L’iPhone 18 Pro (4 288 mAh) se retrouve 12 % en dessous, tandis que l’iPhone 17 Pro (4 252 mAh) affiche un écart presque identique, à -13 %. Plus loin dans le classement, l’iPhone 17e dispose de 4 005 mAh (-18 %), suivi de l’iPhone 17 et de ses 3 692 mAh (-24 %). L’iPhone Air ferme la marche, bon dernier avec ses 3 149 mAh, soit 36 % de moins que le Duo. Ces chiffres concernent les versions eSIM, dont les batteries sont plus généreuses que celles des modèles à SIM physique.
Deux modèles font néanmoins mieux. Avec ses 5 088 mAh, l’iPhone 17 Pro Max dépasse le Duo de 4 %. Quant à l’iPhone 18 Pro Max, il reste le champion incontesté de la gamme avec 5 567 mAh, soit une capacité supérieure de 14 % à celle du modèle pliant.
Une autonomie qui varie selon l’écran utilisé
Les données de lecture vidéo fournies par Apple révèlent une particularité propre au format pliable. Sur l’écran externe, l’iPhone Duo atteint 44 heures, un résultat proche des 45 heures annoncées pour l’iPhone 18 Pro Max et supérieur aux 36 heures de l’iPhone 18 Pro. En revanche, lorsque l’on passe au grand écran intérieur, cette durée tombe à 31 heures.
À titre de comparaison, l’iPhone 17 Pro Max atteint 39 heures, l’iPhone 16 Pro Max et l’iPhone 17 Pro plafonnent à 33 heures chacun, l’iPhone 17 à 30 heures, l’iPhone Air à 27 heures et l’iPhone 17e à 26 heures. Le Duo se place ainsi parmi les modèles les plus endurants lorsque l’on utilise son écran externe, mais son autonomie baisse nettement avec l’écran intérieur.
Tout dépendra donc de la façon dont on utilise l’iPhone Duo. En privilégiant l’écran externe, il peut rivaliser avec les meilleurs iPhone. Mais ceux qui profiteront pleinement du grand écran intérieur, et ce serait dommage de s’en priver, devront composer avec une autonomie plus limitée.
