articles.title: Failles critiques dans PHP : pourquoi vos achats en ligne et vos données bancaires sont menacés — Frandroid
articles.text:
Vous ne connaissez probablement pas PHP, mais vous l’utilisez chaque fois que vous payez sur Internet. En validant un panier, personne ne se soucie des rouages techniques d’un site web, et c’est bien normal. Pourtant, ce langage qui propulse des millions de boutiques en ligne s’apprête à corriger ce mercredi à 16 h deux vulnérabilités critiques. Une véritable course contre la montre pour les administrateurs, mais dont les répercussions concernent directement vos transactions.
    Pour aller plus loin
Failles critiques dans PHP : alerte maximale et mise à jour d’urgence ce mercredi à 16 h
            
Pour comprendre l’ampleur du problème, il faut savoir que PHP est le moteur invisible qui assemble, côté serveur, les pages d’une grande partie du Web, des blogs WordPress aux boutiques WooCommerce ou Magento. D’après les chercheurs en cybersécurité de watchTowr, les deux failles découvertes permettent une exécution de code à distance (RCE). Concrètement, un attaquant peut envoyer ses propres commandes au serveur, qui va leur obéir aveuglément comme s’il s’agissait d’instructions légitimes. Plus inquiétant encore, le défaut se situe dans le cœur même du langage : un site WordPress parfaitement entretenu et à jour reste donc totalement exposé s’il repose sur une version de PHP vulnérable.
Ce qu’un pirate peut faire d’un serveur PHP
Une fois aux commandes du serveur, l’attaquant a l’embarras du choix pour monétiser son intrusion. Sur une boutique en ligne, la technique la plus rentable consiste à glisser discrètement un petit script espion au sein même de la page de paiement. Ce code malveillant va copier les numéros de carte bancaire à la volée, au moment précis où les clients les tapent. On appelle cela une attaque « Magecart », et le piège est redoutable : côté client, la commande passe normalement et personne ne voit rien.
Mais le vol de carte bleue n’est pas le seul risque. L’intrus peut tout aussi bien aspirer l’intégralité de la base de données du commerçant, qui contient vos adresses postales, votre historique d’achats et vos mots de passe (heureusement chiffrés dans la majorité des cas), ou détourner le site vers des pages de phishing.
Un précédent survenu en juin 2024 montre d’ailleurs que la menace n’a rien de théorique. Après la découverte de la faille CVE-2024-4577 (une autre brèche critique dans PHP qui touchait alors les serveurs Windows), le groupe de pirates TellYouThePass avait automatisé ses attaques en un temps record, installant des portes dérobées et chiffrant les données de ses victimes moins de 48 heures après la sortie du correctif.
Pourquoi le correctif ne règle pas tout
Paradoxalement, le danger grimpe en flèche au moment même où le correctif est publié. Dès sa mise en ligne, les pirates comparent l’ancien et le nouveau code pour localiser précisément la faille et lancer des attaques de masse contre les serveurs qui n’ont pas encore été mis à jour.
Or, patcher des millions de machines prend du temps. Beaucoup de petits commerçants utilisent un hébergement mutualisé, où des centaines de sites partagent le même serveur : le propriétaire de la boutique n’a pas la main sur la mise à jour de PHP et dépend entièrement de la réactivité de son hébergeur. Pire, une part importante du Web tourne encore sur de vieilles versions de PHP que le projet ne corrige plus, et qui resteront donc définitivement vulnérables. Enfin, un serveur compromis avant la mise à jour le reste après : le correctif bouche le trou, mais il ne déloge pas les programmes espions que l’intrus a déjà laissés derrière lui.
Quels réflexes adopter pour protéger ses achats ?
Même si vous n’avez aucun moyen de vérifier si votre boutique préférée est bien à jour, quelques réflexes simples permettent de limiter la casse dans les semaines à venir. Le plus efficace concerne le règlement : privilégiez systématiquement Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal ou une carte bancaire virtuelle à usage unique. Ces solutions vous évitent de taper votre vrai numéro de carte dans un formulaire potentiellement espionné par un script.
Côté compte client, les bonnes pratiques habituelles prennent tout leur sens : utilisez un mot de passe unique par site (idéalement généré et stocké dans un gestionnaire) et activez la double authentification lorsqu’elle est disponible. Ainsi, même si la base de données d’un petit site marchand est dérobée, les pirates ne pourront pas réutiliser vos identifiants ailleurs. Enfin, gardez un œil sur vos relevés bancaires et redoublez de méfiance face aux e-mails de « confirmation de commande » ou de « problème de livraison » trop pressants, qui servent souvent de prétexte au phishing après une fuite de données.

articles.title: Hay disturbios y saqueos en Francia, así que Vinted se ha llenado de anuncios muy sospechosos de Sephora, Louis Vuitton y Burberry
articles.text:
Francia vive unos días convulsos marcados por las protestas por el precio de la vida que han acabado con la capital envuelta por el humo de las barricadas en llamas. Entre cargas policiales y disturbios, los escaparates de las tiendas de lujo de Paris saltaron en pedazos y más de 50 comercios se vieron afectadas en solo una noche de disturbios.
Tras unas horas, parte del botín obtenido en esos saqueos busca salida. El lugar elegido es la app en la que media Francia compra vaqueros usados: Vinted.
Una noche que se fue de las manos. Según recogía Euronews con datos del Ministerio de Interior francés, las protestas del 17 de octubre contra el coste de la vida terminaron con saqueos en París, Lyon y otras ciudades. Casi 2.400 personas fueron detenidas y cerca de 1.000 agentes resultaron heridos. El primer ministro, Sébastien Lecornu, habló de una "violencia de extrema intensidad".
Lyon amaneció entre escombros y escaparates rotos. Más de 3.000 comercios sufrieron daños, contaba el loca L'Avenir. Catherine Spindler, presidenta de Sephora en Europa, admitió que varios de sus locales fueron saqueados por los manifestantes.
Un llamamiento a las plataformas de venta. Desde el domingo circulan capturas de anuncios con mercancía que parece robada durante esos saqueos. Anne Le Hénanff, ministra francesa de Asuntos Digitales hacía un llamamiento inmediato a las plataformas de venta de segunda mano como Vinted, Amazon, eBay, Leboncoin, Meta y TikTok.
"Esperamos de estas plataformas que retiren sin demora los anuncios en cuestión", pedía la ministra, al tiempo que advertía a los asaltantes: "Tales comportamientos no quedarán impunes. No dejaremos pasar esto".
Las plataformas han tomado cartas en el asunto. Le Hénanff y su homólogo de Comercio, Serge Papin, y representantes de Justicia e Interior se reunieron de inmediato con las plataformas de venta para bloquear las ventas y llevar a los vendedores ante la justicia.
Varios usuarios denunciaron perfiles de vendedores que vendían bolsas enteras con productos de cosmética de Sephora con etiqueta, zapatillas deportivas, prendas de Louis Vuitton en cuyos anuncios se reconocía explícitamente que habían sido robadas en Paris. En un comunicado enviado al francés Le Monde, Vinted asegura que ha "tomado medidas inmediatas para identificar y eliminar los anuncios vinculados a los saqueos".
La plataforma asegura que aplica una política de "tolerancia cero" hacia la venta de artículos robados y que coopera "activamente" con las autoridades: "Desde este fin de semana, nuestros equipos han actuado de inmediato para identificar y eliminar anuncios que probablemente involucren artículos robados, y hemos reforzado la vigilancia de anuncios sospechosos.
Vinted ya tiene experiencia. En 2023, los disturbios por la muerte de Nahel Merzouk dejaron un escenario de protestas y disturbios muy parecido. Los productos robados en aquellos saqueos también llegaron a las plataformas de venta de segunda mano. Vinted respondió entonces endureciendo sus normas del catálogo y se prohíbe explícitamente vender artículos robados. También dejan fuera los testers y las muestras promocionales no destinados a la venta, algo común en cosmética, para evitar dejar una grieta por la que puedan colarse estos productos.
El Código Penal francés castiga la compra o aceptación de mercancía robada con hasta cinco años de cárcel y 375.000 euros de multa. En este caso, algunos de los anuncios reconocen que se trata de mercancía expoliada de las tiendas, por lo que los compradores de estos productos también están sujetos a sanción porque Vinted lleva el registro de operaciones en su plataforma.

articles.title: TornadoVM 7 Enables GPU-Native Workloads From Java Applications
articles.text:
TornadoVM, an open-source heterogeneous GPU programming framework for Java has reached version 7.3, a major milestone for the project.
InfoQ previously covered the project in December 2025 and in 2022.
TornadoVM automatically accelerates Java programs on multi-core CPUs and GPUs. Rather than replacing existing JVMs, it works alongside them and provides a rich GPU programming ecosystem in Java that you can use with any mainstream JDK distribution such as OpenJDK, Graalvm, Temurin, or Zulu.
It offloads Java code to hardware backends, manages memory between the Java heap and accelerators, and runs the resulting compute kernels. This makes it a useful building block for modern cloud and machine learning workloads.
During development, TornadoVM compiles the source Java code to OpenCL and Apple Metal backends. The idea is that you can develop locally on your laptop and use the hardware available locally, and then deploy into a server that has Nvidia GPUs, and achieve major performance improvements - a form of "Write Once, Run Anywhere" for modern ML workloads.
Version 7 brings several architectural changes. The backends now use the Foreign Function & Memory (FFM) API in place of the Java Native Interface (JNI). The experimental JVM Compiler Interface (JVMCI) dependency has also been removed. According to the team, TornadoVM now sources "all compiler metadata through a reflection + ASM + Unsafe layer" which is the single, uniform path on every supported JDK (21, 25, 26 and 27).
The release also deepens integration with the Nvidia ecosystem through an optimized CUDA backend. This includes support for the cuTile programming model (via a new TileContext) and the ability to call CUDA libraries such as cuBLAS and CUTLASS directly from within TornadoVM TaskGraphs. Developers can swap JIT-generated kernels for CUDA library calls, or chain the two together, depending on their performance and portability needs. Similarly, TornadoVM adds the same functionality for Apple's MXL library again via the hybrid API. Finally, support for multi-GPU execution has been added.
Not every Java computation benefits from offloading. The best candidates are data-parallel workloads, such as loops with no dependencies between iterations, because their iterations can run in parallel on the accelerator.
One of the goals of recent TornadoVM versions is to produce an idiomatic JVM environment for accessing the libraries that Nvidia have been tuning for different hardware platforms. The aim is for Java developers to tap into things like Linear Algebra, Fast Fourier Transforms (for Signal Analysis), Deep Neural Networks and hand-optimized matrix multiplication for sparse matrices. TornadoVM has library integrations with Quarkus, Lang4j, Flink, Spring AI and others and is also available through SDKMan.
For example, consider the integration of Apache Flink with TornadoVM - the main idea is that the developer writes a standard query as they normally would with the Table API. A configuration flag is used to indicate that this query should potentially be accelerated on a GPU.
Then, when the computation reaches the task manager, the framework checks if there is a GPU available in the node it is executing on and, if so, it connects to a library provider - which analyzes the intermediate representation (IR) of the query to see if the computation is actually suitable for GPU execution.
In total, TornadoVM offers four ways to program Nvidia GPUs as a Java programmer - Firstly, the parallel API which is really just an annotation that annotates a loop, and provides a hint for the compiler that this loop can be potentially paralyzed. This simple API did not prove to be sufficient in the long-term to get the desired performance for production applications, so additional APIs were added - such as the kernel context API and the already-mentioned TileContext.
Alongside the 7.3 release, the TornadoVM team introduced jitLLM v2.0, its next-generation Java AI inference engine built on TornadoVM. The team positions jitLLM as a direct competitor to llama.cpp and Ollama in performance, and it ships as a single JAR file.
Both TornadoVM and jitLLM are being commercialized through Beestream.ai, a spin-off founded by the TornadoVM team.
Further details can be found on the TornadoVM site, and also in recent videos from Devoxx Belgium, including: "Tap into the NVIDIA Ecosystem from Java with TornadoVM's Hybrid API".

articles.title: Respan spent two years building on LiteLLM. One upgrade made it start over.
articles.text:
Respan spent two years building on LiteLLM. One upgrade made it start over.
Respan released an open-source AI gateway written in Rust on Tuesday, after spending two years building more than 100,000 lines of wrapper code around LiteLLM.
The new gateway replaces that system with a small core and plugins that handle model providers, routing, MCP tools, realtime voice, and security controls.
A LiteLLM upgrade breaks
The breaking point came in January 2026, when a routine LiteLLM upgrade caused intermittent connection failures. Respan rolled back the update but never figured out the problem.
“We still haven’t figured out the cause,” the company said in its Hacker News launch post.
Since then, its engineers have stopped upgrading LiteLLM directly, instead pulling in upstream fixes one at a time.
A small plugin core
To avoid another maintenance headache, the company borrowed an idea from Nginx, keeping the gateway’s core small and moving features like routing, model providers, and security into plugins. Developers can build their own using the same interfaces, without having to change the underlying code.
Developers can build their own using the same interfaces, without having to change the underlying code.
Some of those integrations are surprisingly small. Respan says its Mistral provider takes just 22 lines of code, while quirks like Groq reporting token usage in a different field can be handled separately. This makes it easier when updating one provider while avoiding the need to change how the rest of the gateway works.
When a request comes in over HTTP or WebSocket, the gateway runs it through the plugins in order. They can decide which model handles it, change the response, make additional calls, or stop the request before it reaches a provider.
When both sides use the same format, the gateway can leave the original request and its provider-specific fields intact.
The gateway can also translate between protocols. An application built for OpenAI’s Realtime API, for example, can connect to Gemini Live without changes to the client, according to Respan, although some features may not carry over. When both sides use the same format, the gateway can leave the original request and its provider-specific fields intact.
Plugins you must compile
Custom plugins are compiled into the gateway, so adding one means maintaining the code and rebuilding the binary. There’s also a security concern. Plugins run inside the gateway process, where they can access model requests and other sensitive data.
Rust helps prevent memory-safety bugs, but it can’t protect against malicious dependencies, or flawed application logic, which is probably why the concern came up following the launch in a Hacker News discussion. One commenter questioned whether compiled crates should even be called plugins, arguing that they force developers to maintain a build pipeline and introduce supply-chain risks. Respan’s founder acknowledged the concern, pointing out that developers can at least inspect the source code they’re compiling.
Plugin order is important, too, which is why Respan processes plugins in the order they’re registered, and one can answer or reject a request before the others run. Put a cache ahead of a security check, for example, and a cached response could bypass that check entirely. Developers need to account for that when configuring the gateway.
LiteLLM’s slower Rust road
Respan isn’t alone in deciding that Rust belongs under an AI gateway. LiteLLM is porting its own gateway to Rust, but where Respan rebuilt from the core out, LiteLLM is moving one route at a time, with the Rust core switched off by default and any request it can’t yet handle falling back to the existing Python path, so turning it on can’t break something Python already served.
The company laid out the plan in June and has said its goal is a pure Rust server that runs every hot path, auth, and rate limiting included, which the current beta doesn’t reach yet.
Respan isn’t alone in deciding that Rust belongs under an AI gateway.
LiteLLM has also published benchmarks claiming its Rust gateway has about seven times less overhead and uses nine times less memory than Bifrost. But those numbers come from LiteLLM’s own tests, using a benchmark harness the company developed.
Respan’s gateway is still pre-alpha, although developers can download a prebuilt binary from GitHub and run it without the company’s paid platform. Custom plugins still require compiling their own build.

articles.title: GTA 6 is on track to smash records as pre-orders exceed 6 million copies
articles.text:
Forward-looking: Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to be the biggest video game launch of 2026 and, quite possibly, the most successful entertainment launch in history. With one month to go before its November 19 release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles, market intelligence firm Sensor Tower has shared its estimates for the game's pre-orders.
As of October 20, Rockstar has pre-sold an estimated 6.45 million copies of the game – earning roughly $630 million in the process. According to Sensor Tower, most – 74% – are buying the game for PlayStation 5. Broken down another way, it works out to 4.8 million copies sold for PS5 and 1.66 million on Xbox.
An earlier estimate from Piper Sandler suggested Rockstar might sell north of 45 million copies of GTA VI come launch.
GTA VI is the highly-anticipated sequel to Grand Theft Auto V, which arrived way back in 2013. It is set in the fictional state of Leonida, which is based on Florida, and looks to be more immersive and interactive than anything we have seen from the franchise to date. Rockstar has been working on the game for over a decade, so to say it has big shoes to fill would be a huge understatement.
GTA VI is priced at $79.99 for the standard edition, or $99.99 for the ultimate edition. Rockstar is also offering a premium collector's set that includes several game-themed goodies for $399.99. Oddly enough, this edition doesn't actually include a copy of the game itself.
Gamers and other major industry players are preparing accordingly. In August, we profiled several gamers that plan to take off from work on launch week in order to binge play the new crime sim. Competing game studios, meanwhile, have adjusted their launch schedules to avoid dropping new games in the same window as GTA VI. Even the military is getting in on the frenzy, with solders at one base reportedly offered time off to play the game in exchange for reenlisting.

articles.title: Del horno al iPhone Duo: así se fabrica el titanio del primer teléfono plegable de Apple
articles.text:
El iPhone Duo es el primer teléfono plegable de Apple. En un video que compartieron en sus redes sociales, la empresa dio a conocer cómo es que se fabrica el titanio que luego termina en su nuevo producto estrella
El titanio que Apple utilizará en el iPhone Duo parte de un proceso industrial que comienza a temperaturas extremas y continúa con varias etapas de transformación. En su planta de Houston, Pensilvania, Perryman Company fundirá, forjará y laminará el material antes de suministrarlo para productos de Apple, incluido el nuevo teléfono plegable.
La compañía indicó que el titanio destinado al iPhone Duo tendrá al menos un 80 % de contenido reciclado. Apple se comprometió a aportar hasta 100 millones de dólares durante los próximos tres años para trabajar con Perryman, una empresa familiar especializada en productos de titanio. El anuncio forma parte de su American Manufacturing Program.
La noticia también llegó a las redes sociales: Apple publicó un carrusel en su cuenta verificada de Instagram, @helloapple, con imágenes del metal al rojo vivo, trabajadores de Perryman y el producto terminado. La publicación presenta la cadena de fabricación como parte de la historia del iPhone Duo y destaca el uso del titanio estadounidense.
Del material reciclado al lingote
El titanio es abundante en la corteza terrestre, pero no suele encontrarse como metal puro. Está unido a otros elementos en minerales y su extracción y procesamiento requieren varias fases. El Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos señala que, aunque el metal puro se aisló en 1910, la producción comercial mediante el proceso Kroll comenzó en 1948.
Para el suministro anunciado, Apple destaca el contenido reciclado y las operaciones de Perryman en Pensilvania. La empresa se presenta como fabricante integrado: controla distintas etapas, desde la fundición del titanio hasta la producción de barras, alambre y otras formas.
Su historia industrial se remonta a 1988; incorporó instalaciones automatizadas de laminado en caliente en 1997, amplió sus procesos de forja y fabricación en 2012 y agregó hornos de fusión por haz de electrones y arco al vacío en 2019 y 2020.
En la fundición, el material se lleva a temperaturas muy elevadas para producir metal que después puede convertirse en lingotes. Perryman emplea hornos de arco al vacío y de haz de electrones para ampliar sus capacidades de fusión.
A partir del lingote, la forja aplica presión para modificar su forma y estructura; luego, el laminado en caliente comprime el metal entre rodillos mientras conserva suficiente temperatura para trabajarlo. De esas fases salen productos intermedios que pueden transformarse en barras, bobinas u otras formas industriales.
Qué significa que sea titanio grado 5
Apple identificó el material como titanio grado 5, una aleación conocida en la industria como Ti-6Al-4V, compuesta principalmente por titanio, aluminio y vanadio. Es una de las aleaciones de titanio más utilizadas en sectores como el aeroespacial y el médico por su combinación de resistencia, bajo peso y resistencia a la corrosión.
Apple sostiene que esta resistencia resulta relevante para el iPhone Duo, cuya estructura debe acompañar un diseño plegable. El teléfono, presentado por la compañía como su primer iPhone plegable, tiene un marco de titanio grado 5 y una cubierta de bisagra hecha con titanio reciclado impreso en 3D, según el anuncio de lanzamiento.
Un recorrido industrial que continúa
La fundición, la forja y el laminado no son el último paso para obtener una pieza lista para un teléfono. Después, el material debe convertirse en componentes con las dimensiones y acabados requeridos. Apple no detalló en su anuncio todas las operaciones posteriores ni el recorrido exacto entre la planta de Perryman y el ensamblaje de la estructura del iPhone Duo.
La alianza conecta una aleación empleada durante décadas en industrias de alta exigencia con un dispositivo de consumo masivo. En las imágenes difundidas por Apple, el titanio aparece primero como metal incandescente y luego como rollos y barras, una manera de mostrar cómo el material atraviesa distintas etapas antes de formar parte del teléfono. La empresa presenta esa fabricación como parte de la historia del iPhone Duo: una estructura resistente concebida para un producto con pantalla plegable.

articles.title: Gemini's Personal Intelligence is coming to cars
articles.text:
Google kicked off 2026 with the addition of Personal Intelligence to Gemini, allowing its AI to pull in more of your data to formulate answers. It started as a paid feature but eventually came to all Gemini users. However, this feature wasn’t available in the car until now. Google is rolling out Personal Intelligence to Android Auto and Google Built-in, and it is still, thankfully, an optional feature.
As Google points out, a generative AI’s outputs are better “when it knows the world and knows you,” which is correct in an uncomfortable sort of way. The more context you can provide to a model, the better the output will be at the end of the token shuffle. Since Google has so much of your data already, it sees Personal Intelligence as a differentiator versus other AI systems. You don’t have to provide the AI context because it already has it from apps like Gmail and Calendar.
Personal Intelligence is beginning its rollout in Android Auto today, and it will come to vehicles with Google built-in in the next few months. As an aside, “Google built-in” is questionable branding, but it refers to cars that run Google software in the infotainment system rather than projecting an interface from your phone. Very few vehicles have Google built-in, but Google often releases new car features on them first. This time, it’s the other way around.
Google says Personal Intelligence is a natural fit for the car, allowing you to focus on the road instead of providing detailed instructions to your digital assistant. For example, you can say “take me to my doctor’s appointment,” and Gemini can get that data from your connected calendar. It can also leverage visual analysis to find locations in your photos to begin navigation.

articles.title: GPUs avaliadas em R$ 2,5 milhões somem do aeroporto de Guarulhos • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
GPUs avaliadas em R$ 2,5 milhões somem do aeroporto de Guarulhos
Cada placa com RTX 5090, da Nvidia, pode custar R$ 35 mil no mercado brasileiro.
Resumo
- Duas cargas de placas de vídeo GeForce RTX 5090 da marca Zotac, avaliadas em R$ 2,5 milhões, sumiram no Aeroporto de Guarulhos.
- As placas, modelo premium da Nvidia, foram trazidas ao Brasil pelo Grupo Oderço e tinham valor aproximado de R$ 35 mil cada no mercado brasileiro.
- A GRU Airport afirmou que trabalha para solucionar o caso e que o Grupo Oderço foi orientado a pedir indenização, mas ainda não há informações sobre a resolução do caso.
Duas cargas de placas de vídeo GeForce RTX 5090 trazidas ao Brasil sumiram neste final de semana no Aeroporto de Guarulhos (GRU), em São Paulo. O caso foi denunciado pelo perfil oficial do Grupo Oderço, responsável pela importação das GPUs. Segundo o post da distribuidora, os dois pallets perdidos representam um prejuízo de R$ 2,5 milhões, o que deve representar centenas de chips gráficos.
A publicação também aponta que não há registros em vídeo do momento em que os componentes foram abduzidos. A empresa cobra um retorno da gestora GRU Airport, responsável pelas operações no aeroporto internacional de São Paulo. Os modelos que sumiram são da marca Zotac. A versão pode ser encontrada a partir de R$ 35 mil no e-commerce nacional.
Em resposta ao G1, a GRU Airport garantiu que “vem empenhando todos os esforços” para solucionar o caso, e que o sumiço das placas de vídeo já foi “reportado às autoridades competentes”. Segundo a concessionária, o Grupo Oderço já recebeu orientações para pedir indenização pela situação.
Placas de vídeo são carga preciosa
As placas RTX 5090 são artigo de luxo para quem deseja montar um PC gamer ou mesmo um computador capaz de rodar softwares de edição e trabalhos mais pesados, por exemplo. Cada unidade abduzida tem valor aproximado de R$ 35 mil no mercado brasileiro, e a Oderço fala em prejuízo de R$ 2,5 milhões considerando o preço de custo.
Modelos do tipo vêm sofrendo uma valorização no mercado por conta da crise dos chips de memória RAM. Cada Zotac RTX 5090 conta com pelo menos 32 GB de RAM GDDR7, padrão mais atual do mercado. A versão também conta com três ventoinhas para resfriamento do sistema, luzes RGB, entre outras características que vão além do componente padrão da Nvidia.
O que acontece agora?
Segundo a concessionária GRU Airport, o sumiço se deu na última quinta-feira (14/10), quando o Grupo Oderço já foi orientado sobre o procedimento para receber uma indenização pelo sumiço dos pallets.
Em nota, a administradora do aeroporto afirmou ainda que a distribuidora precisa apresentar a documentação solicitada para finalizar o processo. Vale ressaltar que a denúncia da empresa aconteceu no sábado (16/10) cobrando esclarecimentos e a localização da carga. Até o momento, não há informações sobre a resolução do caso.

articles.title: Grafana Labs leans on AI agents to automate AI agent observability - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Grafana Labs leans on AI agents to automate AI agent observability
Observability software pioneer Grafana Labs Inc. is flexing its muscles in the rapidly emerging market for artificial intelligence monitoring tools with a swath of updates to its Grafana Cloud platform announced at ObservabilityCON 2026 today.
The startup announced a new suite of AI agents, including Assistant Watchers for monitoring AI workloads and autonomous agents, and Grafana Cloud Agents for remediating problems, in addition to various broader enhancements focused on monitoring and understanding AI telemetry data.
Grafana first made a name for itself in traditional observability with its open-source Grafana platform, and since the turn of the year has aggressively pivoted to focus specifically on AI observability. The original Grafana stack was built to monitor cloud infrastructure and the software applications of yesteryear, and the startup was one of the first to recognize that generative AI applications behave very differently.
Because traditional apps work so differently, legacy observability tools struggled to provide much insight into AI models and agents, making them difficult to debug. Grafana’s solution is to treat agent sessions and large language model conversations as standard telemetry signals, similar to the logs, metrics and traces associated with traditional applications. That way, customers can monitor the performance of these systems in the context of their broader information technology infrastructure.
With the rise of autonomous agents that perform increasingly complex tasks on behalf of humans, Grafana is responding with the launch of highly specialized AI agents that are specifically designed to observe the behavior of those systems. The company said it’s pushing towards “agentic operations,” and a key part of this push is its new Assistant Watchers, which are always-on agents designed to observe and learn the normal telemetry patterns of other agents and flag anomalies in their behavior before bigger problems arise.
Alongside the Assistant Watchers, it’s also launching Grafana Managed Sandboxes in preview, which provide a controlled environment where AI can analyze code in the context of its production behavior and prepare software fixes that can be reviewed by humans. Meanwhile, Pages is a new capability that enables teams to build customized, app-like visualizations of AI workloads that provide deeper insights than its standard dashboards.
Grafana Senior Director of AI Mat Ryer said enterprises want AI agents to take over more work from humans, but if they’re going to do this, they need both evidence and control at each step. “Watchers surface emerging problems, investigations help diagnose them, and Grafana Managed Sandboxes prepare fixes for human review,” he said. “Together they make Grafana Cloud more autonomous, bringing detection, diagnosis and proposed action into one workflow, grounded in the team’s own telemetry.”
Grafana’s agents might be quite sophisticated, but the company recognizes that observability needs to do more than just secure AI workloads. One problem it’s seeking to address is the cost of running AI in the cloud. To do this it’s introducing query performance enhancements in Grafana Cloud Logs, based on technology it obtained through its recent acquisition of Logline. This enables faster full-text search across low-frequency data such as specific request IDs at no additional cost, Grafana said.
Another update is the new Adaptive Logs Archive within Grafana’s Adaptive Telemetry Suite, which allows enterprise users to route logs to their own object storage buckets using open data formats so they can retain observability data at lower cost for future investigations and compliance checks.
Finally, Grafana said, it’s trying to address full-stack visibility across both AI and traditional cloud workloads with the introduction of its new Knowledge Graph and Digital Experience Monitoring capabilities. Knowledge Graph can connect infrastructure and application dependencies with real user experiences, so that both AI agents and human engineers can view a shared runtime context when investigating problems. This capability is augmented by new Mobile Observability and Session Replay tools that enable teams to see issues from the user’s perspective.
“Most teams do not have a monitoring problem,” said Director of Product Richard Lam. “What they have is a technology debt problem: telemetry from every layer and no way to connect it to the customer it affects. Putting a knowledge graph in every Grafana Cloud stack and extending it from the infrastructure to the user makes unified observability foundational instead of something every team has to assemble on its own.”
Today’s announcements indicate that Grafana has a clear vision for what is fast becoming confusing future, in which AI is used for observability and observability is a must for AI.

articles.title: GM to close Detroit battery-assembly plant, but not for reasons you might think | TechCrunch
articles.text:
GM is closing a battery-assembly plant south of Detroit, a spokesperson confirmed to TechCrunch.
The Brownstown Battery Assembly Plant assembled battery packs for Cadillac’s flagship EV, the Celestiq, and both electric drive units (the motors that power the car) and battery packs for the Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray, a plug-in hybrid version of its famous sports car. Automotive News first reported the closure.
The closure is not related to GM’s electric vehicle strategy, the spokesperson said. Instead, GM leased the site, and the lease was nearing its end.
The employees and work at Brownstown will be moved to other GM facilities, though the company would not confirm which ones.
Like many automakers, GM’s electrification strategy was thrown a curveball after the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, the sweeping federal law signed last year, repealed incentives to produce and sell EVs.
Since then, the company has pared back its public comments on EVs, though it hasn’t given up on full electrification.
GM continues to produce a range of EVs, including the Chevrolet Silverado EV and the limited-time-only Chevrolet Bolt. It also continues researching new battery chemistries, including lithium-manganese-rich and sodium-ion, and it’s rolling out a new $900 million facility to speed commercialization.

articles.title: The UFC comes to Toronto next year, and you'll be able to stream it
articles.text:
The Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) is headed back to the six, as the company has announced that UFC 336 will be held at Scotiabank Arena on Jan. 30.
This marks the first time the company has hosted an event in Toronto since 2024, when UFC 297 saw Dricus Du Plessis face off against Sean Strickland. It will be the UFC’s eighth time in Toronto since 2011, and the 39th in Canada.
As expected, there is no announcement yet on who will be on the card, but I wouldn’t be shocked if Burlington, Ontario native Mike Malott is on it. It will also most likely be filled with Canadians, although there are a lot of rumoured star-studded fights for the card, so be on the lookout for that.
The first of many
Now, let’s shift over to the more important stuff: how you can watch it.
The event will be the first of the new year, and the first under the new Paramount+ deal that the UFC signed earlier this year, which means you can watch the main fight on the streaming platform, no pay-per-view needed.
However, it’s a bit of a confusing setup. Any Fight Night events and preliminary fights will still be on Sportsnet/TVA because of contractual obligations between the two. However, what used to be $69.99 will now be streamable on Paramount+.
Tying in to what I said earlier about who is fighting, it would make sense for this card to be more star-studded than more recent Canadian cards, due to the fact that this would be the first one on Paramount+, and it makes sense business-wise to have this be a highly anticipated numbered card in order to drive memberships.
Tickets for UFC 336 in Toronto will go on sale in a month’s time (Nov. 20), but the good news is the fight will be much easier to watch.

At $500, this Intel Core Ultra 7 bundle with free extras is the ideal foundation for your next PC build
You'll still need RAM, storage, and other components, but this is a great deal

• Best for: PC builders putting together a high-performance creative desktop, particularly those planning a white-themed build.
• What we like: On its own, it's a great combo, but Newegg includes a number of promotional extras. There's an MSI MAG CoreLiquid A13 240 Black liquid cooler, valued at $72.49. This features a 240mm radiator, two 120mm ARGB fans, and compatibility with Intel's LGA 1851 socket, so it's suitable for the bundled processor.
Today's best CPU Motherboard combo deal
This bundle combines a 24-core Intel Core Ultra 7 processor with a Gigabyte Z890 motherboard featuring DDR5 support, PCIe 5.0, Wi-Fi 7, Thunderbolt 4, four M.2 slots, and 2.5Gb Ethernet.
Why we recommend it
The Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus is a powerful desktop processor built around Intel's Arrow Lake Refresh architecture. It has 24 cores, comprising eight performance cores and 16 efficiency cores, with 24 threads and a maximum turbo frequency of 5.5GHz.
The Gigabyte Z890 AORUS Elite WiFi 7 Ice motherboard is an ATX model with a white finish. It features four DDR5 memory slots, support for Intel XMP memory profiles, and a 16+1+2-phase power design. You also get a PCIe 5.0 x16 graphics card slot, four M.2 SSD slots, Thunderbolt 4, Wi-Fi 7, and 2.5Gb Ethernet.
Alongside the MSI liquid cooler, there's also an Intel AI Software Bundle 2026, worth $69.99. This gives you a choice of free programs, including Adobe Creative Cloud Pro and Adobe Express Premium. You also get Intel's Motherboard Bundle 2026, worth $59.99. You can choose one of three games: Dying Light: The Beast, Sid Meier's Civilization VII, or Hitman III (World of Assassination).

Price context & historical value
If you bought the processor and motherboard separately, you'd pay a combined $579.99. The current $499.99 bundle price reduces it by $80. The free liquid cooler is a worthy addition because you'd need to buy it otherwise.
The bonus software is another welcome extra, but some offers provide limited subscriptions or require you to pick one title from a choice.
Should you buy it?
✅ Buy the Intel CPU Motherboard Combo if...
You're building a new Intel desktop and want a powerful processor for it. The 24-core CPU can handle demanding tasks, and the motherboard provides plenty of storage expansion and networking options.
❌ Skip the Intel CPU Motherboard Combo if...
You already own a compatible processor and motherboard, or you're looking for a budget PC build. If you're planning an entirely white build, the bundled cooler, which is black, won't match your color scheme.

articles.title: China’s tech giants drop $35 billion on export-compliant Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 workstation GPU orders to power AI ambitions, according to reports — ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent order 3 million cards despite warnings that only 10% of orders are fulfillable
articles.text:
China’s tech giants drop $35 billion on export-compliant Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 workstation GPU orders to power AI ambitions, according to reports — ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent order 3 million cards despite warnings that only 10% of orders are fulfillable
Surging demand for Nvidia's chips in China isn't stopping
Chinese technology giants ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have reportedly spent over $35 billion on orders for more than 3 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 workstation GPUs. The huge order for the RTX Pro 5500, fully compliant with U.S. restrictions on exports of AI-capable GPUs to China, is reportedly far beyond Nvidia's planned production for this card. As a result, Nvidia has, according to sources who spoke to Reuters, told its customers that it isn't in a position to fill the orders as it far outstrips its planned production for this GPU.
The RTX Pro 5500 is a workstation GPU with the same number of CUDA cores as its flagship RTX 5090 GPU, but with 84GB of GDDR7 memory attached, making it a good option for AI applications. The RTX Pro 5500 is a popular choice at the moment for Chinese buyers as exporting it isn't currently restricted by the U.S. government. It's less powerful than the H200 and B300, Nvidia's AI-focused GPUs for the enterprise market, but those GPUs remain either banned or heavily restricted. As China competes with the U.S. in the race to produce newer, better AI models, GPUs like the RTX Pro 5500 continue to be indispensable.
The report reveals some interesting data about the Chinese tech firms orders. Two of its sources revealed that the cards are priced at around $11,400 each, reaching a total order value of $35 billion. Meanwhile, another source suggested that Nvidia has informed its partners that it may only be able to deliver enough cards to meet between 5% and 10% of the demand. Meanwhile, Nvidia is reportedly in a position to only produce 3 million RTX Pro 5500 cards globally in 2027.
Neither Nvidia nor the three Chinese companies have confirmed any of this on the record. However, an Nvidia spokesman told Reuters that demand from the Chinese market for these chips has faced "unprecedented growth since 2022" since export restrictions were introduced. "U.S. firms continue to be restricted by a combination of outdated U.S. export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly half a decade ago, and China's own limits on U.S. imports."
While trade hostility between the U.S. and China shows no sign of abating, demand for Nvidia's GPUs hasn't slowed down, despite U.S. attempts to restrict Nvidia's ability to export to China. Meanwhile, export-restricted Nvidia AI chips continue to reach China despite the restrictions, bypassing the Trump administration's efforts in the process.

articles.title: Prime Video tient sa série ultime pour Halloween avec Carrie, un raz-de-marée mondial
articles.text:
Prime Video a sorti la série un peu plus de trois semaines avant Halloween, en pleine saison des programmes d’horreur. Ce mardi 20 octobre, Carrie est toujours la série la plus regardée de Prime Video dans le monde, selon le classement de FlixPatrol, et elle est en tête aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni comme en France.
Prime Video frappe fort avec Carrie
Amazon a confié le premier roman de Stephen King à Mike Flanagan (The Haunting of Hill House, Midnight Mass), qui avait déjà adapté l’écrivain au cinéma avec Jessie en 2017 et Doctor Sleep en 2019. Il pilote la série, en signe le scénario et réalise quatre des huit épisodes. Stephen King en est producteur exécutif.
Pour le scénario, on retrouve Summer H. Howell qui joue Carrie White, la lycéenne harcelée, et Samantha Sloyan sa mère Margaret, une fanatique religieuse. Amber Midthunder et Matthew Lillard, qui joue le proviseur du lycée, font partie de la distribution principale. Nous avons détaillé ce que vaut cette relecture, entre harcèlement scolaire, fanatisme religieux et télékinésie, dans notre critique complète de la série.
Huit épisodes à voir avant Halloween
Carrie sort dans un mois chargé en films et séries d’horreur, et mêle scènes sanglantes et drame psychologique. Côté critique, la série obtient 86 % d’avis positifs sur Rotten Tomatoes (126 critiques recensées), même si ses libertés avec le roman divisent.
Les huit épisodes, de 48 à 59 minutes chacun, sont tous en ligne depuis le 7 octobre, soit environ sept heures à caser avant le soir du 31 octobre.
Alors que la période est traditionnellement saturée de productions horrifiques au rabais, Carrie s’impose comme la seule (du moins la rare) proposition majeure capable de conjuguer horreur viscérale et drame psychologique d’une justesse assez terrifiante. Les réseaux sociaux étouffent sous les réactions, propulsant le show au rang de phénomène pop-culturel incontournable de cet automne. Clairement.

articles.title: L'ancien patron de Google a misé sur Claude en 2021 : sa part dans Anthropic pourrait valoir 20 milliards en Bourse
articles.text:
Eric Schmidt fait partie des premiers investisseurs d’Anthropic, l’entreprise derrière Claude. Cinq ans après son investissement, sa participation pourrait atteindre une valeur colossale lors de l’introduction en Bourse de la start-up. Encore faut-il que Wall Street accepte de payer le prix fort.
En 2021, Anthropic n’était encore qu’une jeune pousse de l’intelligence artificielle, loin de peser les centaines de milliards qu’on lui prête aujourd’hui. Eric Schmidt, lui, avait déjà sorti son carnet de chèques. Selon Bloomberg, l’ancien directeur général de Google aurait investi plusieurs dizaines de millions de dollars dans l’entreprise, un pari particulièrement lucratif puisqu’il détiendrait aujourd’hui environ 1% de son capital.
À l’approche de son introduction en Bourse, cette participation pourrait représenter jusqu’à 20 milliards de dollars. De quoi faire passer son investissement initial dans une tout autre dimension.
Un investissement réalisé quand Anthropic ne valait que 461 millions de dollars
Eric Schmidt avait participé en 2021 à une levée de fonds de 124 millions de dollars, menée par Jaan Tallinn, cofondateur de Skype. À l’époque, Anthropic était valorisée à seulement 461 millions de dollars.
Depuis, le succès de Claude et l’explosion des dépenses consacrées à l’IA ont considérablement changé la donne. En mai dernier, une nouvelle levée de fonds valorisait déjà l'entreprise à 965 milliards de dollars. À ce niveau, le petit pourcentage détenu par Schmidt représenterait environ 9,7 milliards.
Mais certains investisseurs envisagent désormais une entrée en Bourse comprise entre 1 800 et 2 000 milliards de dollars. Dans le scénario le plus favorable, sa participation atteindrait donc les fameux 20 milliards, sous réserve que sa participation représente toujours environ 1% du capital lors de l’introduction sur le marché.
L'ancien dirigeant de Google n’a pas souhaité commenter ces informations. Il n’en est toutefois pas à son premier investissement dans l’IA, puisqu’il a également soutenu Mistral AI, Reflection AI et World Labs, notamment à travers ses structures d’investissement.
Les investisseurs ne sont pas tous prêts à payer le prix fort
Anthropic pourrait commencer à présenter ses actions aux investisseurs dès la semaine du 9 novembre avec une première cotation envisagée avant Thanksgiving, voire d’ici la fin de l’année. Rien n’est encore définitivement arrêté.
Surtout, les valorisations avancées font débat. Après des résultats trimestriels marqués par un ralentissement de la croissance, certains investisseurs privilégieraient désormais une estimation de 1 500 milliards de dollars. La participation de Schmidt vaudrait alors 15 milliards, ce qui reste une somme considérable.
Dans le scénario le plus bas de son analyse, le cabinet américain New Constructs aboutit ainsi à une valorisation de 144 milliards de dollars, très loin des montants envisagés pour l’introduction en Bourse. Pour Eric Schmidt, la bonne affaire est donc encore largement théorique.

articles.title: Adiós al blooming: así evoluciona el MiniLED con la novena generación de TCL y su tecnología SQD-MiniLED
articles.text:
El mercado de los televisores lleva unos años girando alrededor de una idea clara: el MiniLED se ha consolidado como la alternativa más sólida para quienes buscan un gran brillo y negros profundos sin dar el salto directo a los paneles OLED. Sin embargo, la carrera por presumir de cifras cada vez más altas en las especificaciones técnicas ha chocado a menudo con un problema en entornos reales: la gestión del color y los molestos halos de luz (blooming).
Con la presentación de su novena generación de tecnología de pantalla, bautizada como SQD-MinLED (Super Quantum Dot), TCL busca precisamente equilibrar esa ecuación. Tras años impulsando esta tecnología desde que lanzó el primer MiniLED en el mercado en 2019, la marca traslada su desarrollo de paneles (a través de su filial TCL CSOT) a una nueva familia de televisores.
TCL 55Q7D Pro 55 Pulgadas SQD-Mini LED 4K HDR10+ Smart TV
TCL 75X11L 75 Pulgadas SQD-Mini LED 4K HDR10+ Smart TV
¿En qué consiste el SQD-MiniLED?
Hasta ahora, la combinación de MiniLED y puntos cuánticos (Quantum Dots) se centraba en utilizar miles de diodos diminutos tras el panel para controlar la luz por zonas. La evolución hacia el SQD-MiniLED ataca a dos problemas para mejorar la experiencia visual en el día a día:
- Tratamiento cromático más preciso: introduce un nuevo material de puntos cuánticos (Super QLED) combinado con un filtro de color de alta precisión (Ultra Color Filter), diseñado para mantener la fidelidad y la intensidad de los colores según el estándar cinematográfico BT.2020, incluso en las escenas más luminosas.
- Control drástico del blooming: mediante una arquitectura óptica perfeccionada, se busca minimizar los halos de luz que suelen aparecer alrededor de los objetos brillantes sobre fondos oscuros, uno de los talones de Aquiles tradicionales de esta tecnología.
Los nuevos modelos: así queda el catálogo
Esta novena generación no se queda en simple teoría, sino que se despliega en varias gamas diseñadas para diferentes perfiles de usuarios:
- TCL X11L: el buque insignia de la marca. Está enfocado directamente a los entusiastas de la tecnología y del cine en casa que buscan el máximo rendimiento visual sin concesiones.
TCL 75X11L 75 Pulgadas SQD-Mini LED 4K HDR10+ Smart TV
- TCL C8L: se posiciona como una opción de corte prémium orientada a quienes buscan montar una experiencia de gran formato en salones amplios.
TCL 85C8L 85 Pulgadas SQD-Mini LED 4K HDR10+ Smart TV, 6.000 Nits
- TCL C7L y Q7D Pro: los modelos pensados para llevar esta tecnología a un público más amplio. El C7L actúa como un televisor todoterreno para el uso diario (series, deportes o consolas), mientras que el Q7D Pro se plantea como la puerta de entrada más accesible a las ventajas del SQD-MiniLED.
TCL 85C7L 85 Pulgadas SQD-Mini LED 4K HDR10+ Smart TV
TCL 55Q7D Pro 55 Pulgadas SQD-Mini LED 4K HDR10+ Smart TV
En el apartado acústico, la marca ha apostado por alianzas de peso: los modelos X11L, C8L y C7L integran un sistema de sonido avanzado firmado por Bang & Olufsen, mientras que el modelo Q7D Pro confía en un sistema Onkyo 2.1.

TCL A65K Barra de Sonido 3.1.2ch

articles.title: Revolut victime d'une panne majeure : les paiements touchés, la banque réagit
articles.text:
« Nous pouvons confirmer que tout l’argent et les données de nos clients sont en sécurité » : Revolut a posté un message sur le réseau social X, alors qu’un nombre conséquent de ses clients européens n’arrive plus à utiliser ses services. Que ce soit les paiements par carte ou l’accès à l’application, Revolut semble être à l’arrêt. L’origine de la panne se situerait au niveau de l’un de ses prestataires.
Revolut victime d’une panne majeure
Depuis environ 8 heures du matin, la néobanque Revolut est victime d’une panne majeure. Un nombre conséquent de ses clients ne parviennent pas à payer par carte et à accéder à l’application. Le problème toucherait plusieurs pays européens, dont la France. Sur sa page de suivi de l’état du système, Revolut signale une panne touchant l’ensemble de ses 31 services surveillés.
L’origine de la panne se situerait au niveau de Google Cloud, c’est-à-dire l’un de ses prestataires. Selon Sky News, Google Cloud a signalé des « problèmes » dans sa région Europe de l’Ouest affectant des dizaines de sites web, dont Revolut, Royal Mail et HSBC. Il ne serait donc pas question d’une cyberattaque visant Revolut. Cependant, ces informations restent à confirmer.
Revolut réagit
Sur le réseau social X, Revolut explique : « Nous rencontrons actuellement une interruption de service affectant plusieurs services. Nous pouvons confirmer que tout l’argent et les données de nos clients sont en sécurité. Nous travaillons à résoudre le problème depuis qu’il a été identifié ce matin et nous présentons nos excuses à toute personne touchée ainsi que pour tout désagrément causé ».
La néobanque ne confirme donc pour l’instant pas l’origine de la panne. Des vérifications approfondies doivent sans doute encore être menées, mais Revolut semble en mesure d’affirmer que l’argent de ses clients et leurs données confidentielles sont en sécurité. En tout cas, bon nombre de clients Revolut sont actuellement dans l’incapacité d’effectuer des paiements, physiques ou en ligne. Patience donc, Revolut devrait bientôt rétablir la situation. Du moins, on l’espère.

articles.title: PHP warns admins of two critical flaws, emergency patches coming tomorrow
articles.text:
The PHP security team is warning administrators to prepare for emergency security updates tomorrow to address two critical vulnerabilities, as information about the flaws has reportedly leaked ahead of their scheduled disclosure.
PHP powers many websites and web applications, including content management systems, e-commerce platforms, and custom web services.
In an advisory published Tuesday, the PHP development team announced that it plans to release security updates on Wednesday, October 21, at 14:00 UTC (10:00 AM Eastern), to address two vulnerabilities, each rated 9.2 under CVSS v4.0.
The PHP security team also sent a notice to its ANNOUNCE mailing list, urging administrators to prepare to install the security updates as soon as they become available.
"We reserve the right to release earlier should details of either vulnerability become public, or should evidence of active exploitation appear in the wild," the PHP security team warned.
The developers have not disclosed any technical details about the vulnerabilities, including which PHP versions are affected, how they can be exploited, or which releases will contain fixes.
However, security researchers at watchTowr told BleepingComputer that the vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, are remote code execution (RCE) flaws believed to affect PHP versions 5, 6, 7, and 8.
"In the last hour, two remote code execution vulnerabilities in PHP have been leaked. These vulnerabilities were previously scheduled under embargo and due for release on Thursday at 11 am ET," watchTowr CEO Benjamin Harris told BleepingComputer.
"While we are not able to share technical information at this point for obvious reasons, given the sensitivity, we can confirm that these vulnerabilities are indeed real. Both of them are CVSS10 and are understood to affect PHP versions 5, 6, 7, and 8."
watchTowr also said it believes it has successfully reproduced CVE-2026-109618 but is not releasing technical information until security patches become available.
The researchers clarified that they have not observed exploitation of the vulnerabilities in the wild, despite the information reportedly leaking ahead of the planned disclosure.
In a post on X, watchTowr warned that information about the vulnerabilities had leaked before the originally planned disclosure date.
"We were all supposed to wait until Thursday at 11am ET. Information has leaked wrt zero-day embargoed RCE vulns in PHP. We can confirm that they're real," the researchers said.
The warning follows a now-deleted post on Y Combinator's Hacker News forum, in which a user named "petecooper" claimed that two critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities would be disclosed on October 22.
The post, seen by BleepingComputer, claimed that both vulnerabilities carried CVSS scores of 10.0 and affected PHP versions dating back to PHP 5.
It also identified the vulnerabilities as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, matching the identifiers watchTowr later shared.
However, watchTowr's statements and the Hacker News post are different from PHP's official announcement. Both described the vulnerabilities as CVSS 10.0, while the PHP security team assigned each a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.2.
Additionally, watchTowr cited an originally planned Thursday disclosure, while PHP has officially scheduled its security release for tomorrow morning.
The PHP security team says it will publish full technical details, affected versions, and fixed releases when the security updates become available.

articles.title: India-New Zealand trade pact kicks in
articles.text:
India-New Zealand trade pact kicks in
The agreement provides duty-free access to a range of Indian goods, including products from labour-intensive sectors such as textiles and leather.
The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA), signed on April 27, came into effect on Tuesday, providing duty-free access to a range of Indian goods, including products from labour-intensive sectors such as textiles and leather.
It is the seventh trade pact to come into force in the last five years. The others are agreements with the UAE, Mauritius, the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) bloc, the UK, Oman and Australia.
Signed on April 27, 2026, the agreement follows negotiations launched in 2010, stalled in 2015 and revived in March 2025. The pact becomes India's 17th operational FTA.
According to experts, the sectors benefiting from the FTA are textiles and apparel, leather and footwear, engineering goods and auto components, gems and jewellery, agriculture and processed foods, pharmaceuticals, and other manufacturing industries.
Gulzar Didwania, Partner, Deloitte India, said the deal is expected to support higher FDI inflows into India, but the scale of any increase remains uncertain and will depend on private-sector investment decisions.
New Zealand has committed FDI worth USD 20 billion in over 15 years.
"The FTA's provisions on duty-free access for certain inputs, bilateral cumulation, customs facilitation, and investment-promotion mechanisms may encourage deeper value-chain integration and improve investment conditions," he said.
He added that the pact has significance beyond trade, strengthening India's strategic position in the Indo-Pacific, expanding its network of FTAs with developed economies.
At a time of growing global trade uncertainty, the India-New Zealand FTA is a strong endorsement of open markets and predictable trade rules. Its target of doubling bilateral trade by 2030 sets an ambitious agenda for both countries.
What makes this FTA particularly valuable is that it goes beyond goods to cover services, investment, skills and mobility, creating fresh opportunities for Indian professionals and businesses.
With 100 per cent of Indian exports gaining duty-free access to New Zealand from day one, the agreement gives Indian exporters a significant competitive advantage. MSMEs in textiles, leather, footwear and engineering goods are particularly well placed to benefit.
Economic think tank Chintan Research Foundation (CRF India) President Shishir Priyadarshi said that at a time of growing global trade uncertainty, the India-New Zealand FTA is a strong endorsement of open markets and predictable trade rules.
"What makes this FTA particularly valuable is that it goes beyond goods to cover services, investment, skills and mobility, creating fresh opportunities for Indian professionals and businesses," he said.
Trade expert and Hi-Tech Gears Chairman Deep Kapuria said the FTA operationalisation with New Zealand completes India's preferential market access in all major countries of the Asia-Pacific region.
"New Zealand is a very open economy; India has very well crafted this trade deal by securing market access for new services such as Ayush, yoga instructors and student mobility, including post-study work visa," he said.
Bilateral trade declined by about 11 per cent to USD 1.15 billion in 2025-26 from USD 1.3 billion in the previous fiscal year. India's exports stood at USD 566.51 million, while imports were USD 589.1 million, resulting in a meagre trade deficit of USD 22.59 million for India.
Rani Singh, Indian-origin New Zealander, said the deal is an important step forward for both countries as it is not just about trade; it is about bringing the two countries closer, creating opportunities for businesses and people, and building a stronger relationship for the future.
"India now has an opportunity to build its own strong partnership with New Zealand. With duty-free access to New Zealand for all Indian export tariff lines from day one, Indian businesses can become more competitive in this market," she said.
Singh added that the benefits are not limited to goods as there is also scope for greater cooperation in education, tourism, technology, professional services and investment.
Greater opportunities for eligible skilled professionals and young people can further strengthen these connections, she said.

articles.title: “Todas las empresas fabricarán cerebros y tendrán dos fábricas, la real y la digital”: Jensen Huang, CEO de Nvidia
articles.text:
Jensen Huang sorprendió a la audiencia de un foro empresarial en Alemania con una afirmación que puede dividir opiniones: en el futuro, cada compañía fabricará cerebros digitales para integrarlos en sus productos.
El director ejecutivo de Nvidia planteó que “cada empresa tendrá dos fábricas en el futuro: la fábrica que es real y la fábrica que es digital, y la fábrica digital será tan real que prácticamente será real”.
Huang fue más allá y proyectó que “la mayoría de la gente en Alemania trabajará principalmente dentro de un gemelo digital de su empresa”. En ese escenario, las personas “construirán autos digitales” que “tendrán cerebros digitales”. Las fábricas, por su parte, incorporarán inteligencia artificial y robots que construirán, a su vez, vehículos robóticos.
Esta idea responde a un concepto que ya existe en el mundo industrial: el gemelo digital, una réplica virtual de un objeto, proceso o sistema físico que se alimenta en tiempo real con datos de la operación real. El propósito de esta tecnología es permitir simulaciones y ajustes sin asumir riesgos sobre la producción física.
Cuál es el significado detrás de “fabricar cerebros”
La frase que generó más repercusión fue la conclusión de Huang: “Cada empresa construirá dos cosas: cerebros, y los cerebros que van a los productos que venden”. Con ello, el CEO de Nvidia resumió su tesis central: todo proceso productivo estará “completamente impulsado por software” y “completamente impulsado por inteligencia artificial”.
En términos simples, lo que Huang describe es que cada empresa deberá levantar dos líneas de desarrollo paralelas: una dedicada a entrenar sistemas de inteligencia artificial (los “cerebros”) y otra encargada de incorporar esos sistemas dentro de los bienes físicos que fabrica y comercializa, desde automóviles hasta maquinaria industrial.
Un artículo de la revista estadounidense Gizmodo señaló que esta formulación resulta una versión menos clara de otra que el propio Huang había presentado antes en una conferencia, donde explicó que “cada industria, cada compañía que tenga fábricas, tendrá dos fábricas en el futuro: la fábrica para lo que construyen, y la fábrica para las matemáticas, la fábrica para la IA”.
Según esa publicación, el concepto de una fábrica digital que simula cada fábrica real remite a una función del catálogo de herramientas de Nvidia llamada Omniverse, diseñada para simular entornos robóticos con fines de prueba antes de aplicar esos procesos en plantas reales.
El consejo de Jesen Huang a los niños y estudiantes
El fundador y director ejecutivo de Nvidia pidió a los jóvenes que no abandonen la educación formal y que aprendan a usar la inteligencia artificial como herramienta de apoyo. “Vayan a la escuela” y “adopten la IA”, recomendó en una entrevista con CNN.
Consultado sobre qué conviene estudiar ante el avance de las herramientas generativas, Huang evitó señalar una carrera específica. “No sé qué carrera será la más exitosa, pero sí puedo decirles lo que les digo a mis hijos”, afirmó.
Sostuvo que la formación académica permite comprender mejor el mundo, revisar sesgos y tomar decisiones con más información, más allá de que las profesiones más demandadas dentro de una década aún no estén definidas.
Su segundo consejo fue que los jóvenes se involucren con la inteligencia artificial de forma activa: “Adopten la IA, aprendan qué puede hacer y no se rindan con ella”, sin que eso reemplace el esfuerzo personal.
Huang cuestionó los discursos que presentan los estudios como una pérdida de tiempo frente a la automatización. “Que crean que ir a la escuela es una pérdida de tiempo y dinero es algo horrible”, remarcó.
El planteo se da mientras gobiernos e instituciones educativas debaten cómo incorporar la IA generativa en las aulas. El Fondo Monetario Internacional calcula que cerca del 40% de los empleos del mundo está expuesto a transformaciones vinculadas con esta tecnología.

articles.title: Social media platforms have racked up $26 billion in privacy penalties since 2020
articles.text:
Think social media protects your data? Platforms have racked up $26 billion in privacy penalties since 2020
Meta alone accounts for $23.7 billion in penalties across the US and Europe, as regulators crack down on data harvesting and child safety lapses.
- Social platforms have incurred over $26 billion in privacy fines and settlements globally since 2020.
- Meta platforms (Facebook and Instagram) accounted for $23.7 billion (91%) of all penalties.
- The US led enforcement with $20.9 billion in fines, followed by European regulators at $5.16 billion.
Social media platforms thrive on personal data, but failing to protect it is proving exceptionally costly. Since 2020, the world’s top 10 social networks have accumulated more than $26 billion in privacy-related fines and regulatory settlements worldwide.
According to a study published by cybersecurity firm Surfshark, the lion's share of this astronomical financial penalty belongs to one parent company: Meta.
Between Facebook and Instagram, Mark Zuckerberg’s tech empire is responsible for an overwhelming 91% of the worldwide total, racking up $23.7 billion in penalties.
Meta dominates the penalty board
Facebook alone accumulated $14.3 billion in penalties, while Instagram accounted for $9.4 billion. TikTok placed a distant third, tallying $1.6 billion in fines across global jurisdictions.
Other familiar platforms also faced notable regulatory actions. LinkedIn accrued $360 million, YouTube followed with $222 million, and X (formerly Twitter) totaled $151 million. Further down the list, Snapchat recorded $35 million in fines, Reddit registered $19 million, and Discord logged $928,000. Pinterest stood out as the sole platform in the study with zero qualifying privacy penalties.
The United States spearheaded the financial enforcement, imposing $20.9 billion, roughly 80% of all global fines examined. The single largest penalty came from a massive $17.1 billion US settlement involving Facebook and Instagram over allegations that inadequate safeguards exposed minors to deliberately addictive product features.
American authorities also levied $3.69 billion strictly for data-processing offenses, led by Facebook ($2.9 billion), TikTok ($593 million), and X ($150 million). TikTok additionally received an independent $100 million penalty in 2026 over inadequate security safeguards.
European regulators target cross-border transfers and GDPR
Across the Atlantic, European authorities have imposed $5.16 billion in fines under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and national frameworks.
Ireland served as the focal point of enforcement, issuing $4.87 billion, or 94% of Europe’s total, largely because many tech giants maintain their regional headquarters in Dublin. France trailed at $245 million, followed by the UK at $36 million.
Europe’s two heaviest individual fines stemmed from unauthorized international data transfers:
Facebook received a $1.39 billion fine for transferring EU user data to US servers.
TikTok was hit with a $615 million fine for transferring European user data to China, echoing wider scrutiny surrounding apps with ties to foreign jurisdictions.
European regulators also penalized platforms $1.22 billion for unlawful data processing, $1.09 billion for data breach incidents, and $594 million for insufficient technical security safeguards. Regulatory bodies in South Korea and Australia added further pressure, issuing $62.4 million and roughly $50.5 million in fines, respectively.
As lawmakers worldwide tighten regulations, whether battling data misuse or debating proposals that weaken encryption, these multi-billion-dollar sums send an unmistakable message: user privacy can no longer be treated as an afterthought.

articles.title: AI is everywhere in Zoom product blitz - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
AI is everywhere in Zoom product blitz
Zoom Communications Inc. is expanding beyond videoconferencing with a shared intelligence layer designed to help artificial intelligence agents turn meetings, calls and customer interactions into completed work across business applications.
Announced at the Zoomtopia virtual conference, the Unified Context Layer anchors updates spanning workplace collaboration, customer service, developer tools, security, events and sales. The company’s strategy aims to address a persistent problem with enterprise AI: Assistants can capture conversations but often lack the history, permissions and connections needed to act on them.
Zoom combines conversation intelligence with documents and information from connected systems such as Salesforce Inc.’s customer relationship management, ServiceNow Inc.’s workflow management platform and Workday Inc.’s human capital management application. It builds a graph linking people, topics and decisions and updates those relationships in near real time, so agents don’t have to reconstruct context for each request.
“The context layer has already synthesized and distilled that information,” Chief Product Officer Russell Dicker said during a briefing. In internal benchmarks, he said the approach reduced costs by 45% to 65% compared with standalone agents parsing information individually. Zoom did not provide independent validation of that comparison.
The layer, available now, provides shared memory and agent coordination across Zoom Workplace, customer experience products and connected applications.
Agent coordination
ZoomMate Agent Teams, also available now, assigns specialized agents to different parts of a project simultaneously, with a lead agent coordinating tasks and combining their output for human review. Agentic search draws answers from Zoom and more than 40 third-party applications.
The My Notes note-taker is expanding from meeting capture into workflow automation. Users will be able to send summaries to Salesforce, Zoom Chat and other destinations using templates or natural-language instructions. A forthcoming standalone mobile app and recording devices from DTEN Inc. and GalaxySailLab Inc.’s Bota extend capture to in-person conversations.
Other additions let invited users receive personalized transcripts and summaries when they miss meetings and link screenshots to relevant transcript passages. Zoom for Business Owners connects meeting context with Zoom’s Bonsai business management and client engagement platform to support proposals, client work and billing.
Within Workplace, Zoom is upgrading translation so a speaker can broadcast translated audio to participants without requiring each listener to hold a separate license (pictured). Voice cloning is intended to preserve the speaker’s vocal identity. Other features smooth voices and accents, adjust video when participants glance away and support screen sharing at 60 frames per second.
A planned live meeting assistant will privately suggest answers and guide pacing and engagement.
“It helps you in real time, looking up answers the second a question comes your way and keeping conversations on track,” said Leo Bolton, who leads product solutions and industry marketing at Zoom.
A redesigned Chat feature lets agents participate alongside employees, while consolidating replies and activity. A Threads page aggregates replies across conversations into a single inbox, while an Activity page organizes mentions, reactions and threads in chronological order. AI-generated meeting icebreakers like word clouds and quizzes, simpler navigation and refreshed calling controls round out the interface changes.
Physical workspace updates include AI-generated digital signage, personal account access in shared Zoom Rooms and expanded Microsoft Corp. Teams interoperability. Zoom is also adding native support for compatible Cisco Systems Inc. hardware and Google LLC Beam immersive meetings. Phone additions include WhatsApp messaging and planned virtual receptionist capabilities for text inquiries and call screening.
Zoom is opening the same intelligence to outside applications through expanded Model Context Protocol servers and Search and Ask application programming interfaces. Supported assistants can retrieve context or perform Zoom actions without opening its interface, while an administration server will support conversational configuration.
Host of AI services
Fifteen new AI services include voice agents, interpretation, transcription, speech summarization and structured decision outputs. Developers can use managed voice pipelines or supply their own language models. Platform Studio brings AI Services, Video software development kit and Co-Browse SDK into one portal.
“In simple terms, it’s your data, your tools, your choice,” Bolton said. “The intelligence moves with the work.”
For customer service, Zoom is introducing profiles that combine CRM records, engagement history and linked cases across Contact Center and Phone. Executives said the goal is to preserve knowledge as customers move between channels, virtual agents and employees.
Zoom Virtual Agent is expanding into physical kiosks for retail, healthcare and other settings. Multimodal capabilities let customers show products to a virtual agents via a camera, with unresolved requests escalated to employees or remote experts. Agent Architect can generate virtual agent flows from call transcripts.
Source Hub will initially connect Salesforce records directly to the agent desktop for viewing and updating. Customer Workflow Orchestrator can automate follow-up processes, pause for external events and resume when conditions are met.
CX Insights adds natural-language analysis of transcripts alongside operational metrics, recommended actions and executive briefs. Quality Management expands into third-party cases and AI role-playing for agent training. A new spending feature pools annual commitments across seats, applications and AI capabilities.
“This is what it looks like when you truly stop treating your customer interactions as disconnected tickets and start treating them as one continuous story,” said Michelle Couture, Zoom’s customer experience product marketing lead.
The Zoom Events virtual conference platform is getting updates including Content Studio, which repurposes recordings into multilingual clips, posts and images, plus AI-assisted event setup and conversational analytics.
Zoom Revenue Accelerator adds prospecting, lead enrichment and outreach that can continue until meetings are booked. Workflow automation detects stalled deals, while Revenue OS connects buying signals, routing, engagement and forecasting.
Broader access to business information raises governance requirements that Zoom said it’s addressing with sensitivity labels that can be synchronized with Microsoft Purview or used with native classifications to enforce handling policies. Centralized AI management will add visibility, audits and administrative controls, while custom guardrails are designed to restrict sensitive information in outputs and require human review where specified.
Planned deepfake detection analyzes video and audio and assigns confidence scores to suspected cases of external manipulation. Compliance Manager support for the My Notes note-taker and Canvas (formerly Zoom Docs) will archive AI-generated content for retention and supervision. Many of the announced features are scheduled for release through early 2027.
Dicker said administrators could inspect agent activity, shut down agents that violate policy, and review the sources behind responses. The company also allows for human review before high-stakes actions and feedback mechanisms to improve accuracy.
“The unified context layer doesn’t just aggregate data,” Dicker said. “It also thinks about things like respecting permissions, compliance policies, and data governance rules that are at every layer.”
